title: Technical Product Manager
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
The Technical Platform Manager (TPM) is responsible for driving the strategy, roadmap, adoption, governance, and delivery of enterprise platform services that enable secure, scalable, and efficient software development and infrastructure operations across the organization.
  
  
This role partners with platform service owners, engineering leaders, architecture, security, compliance, cloud engineering, and application development teams to define platform capabilities, establish operational excellence standards, drive platform adoption, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The TPM serves as a strategic leader who balances platform scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, and cost optimization while ensuring enterprise platform services continue to meet evolving business and technology needs.
  
  
Platform domains may include Data Ingestion, Data Quality, ETL, Web Applications, Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management , Developer Tooling, and Internal Developer Platforms.
  
  
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
**Data Platform Strategy & Roadmap Management**

* Define and manage the product roadmap for enterprise data acquisition, ingestion, correction, storage, and distribution platforms, including:

+ Data Acquisition & Onboarding Services
+ Data Ingestion Pipelines (Batch and Real-Time)
+ Data Quality & Validation Services
+ Data Correction Platforms (Consumer, Commercial, Fraud, MFI)
+ Enterprise Data Store (EDS)
+ Data Publishing & Distribution Services
+ CDC, Streaming, and Event-Driven Architecture
+ Redis and Low-Latency Data Access Platforms
+ Data APIs and Data-as-a-Service Capabilities

* Establish product vision and strategy for enterprise data platforms aligned with business growth, regulatory requirements, and customer needs.
* Drive prioritisation of platform investments that improve data quality, scalability, timeliness, availability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product, Analytics, and Operations teams to define roadmap alignment, capability evolution, and technical strategy.
* Balance regulatory obligations, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and business-driven feature delivery.

**Data Product Adoption & Customer Success**

* Drive adoption of enterprise data platform capabilities across internal and external consumers.
* Develop deep understanding of data providers, operational users, analytics teams, product teams, and application consumers.
* Establish feedback loops with stakeholders to continuously improve data acquisition, correction, fulfilment, and data access experiences.
* Measure and report product adoption, service utilisation, customer satisfaction, data quality improvements, and business value realization.
* Champion self-service capabilities that enable data onboarding, monitoring, corrections, and operational management with minimal engineering intervention.

**Data Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Define and maintain operational frameworks governing data ingestion, validation, correction, retention, distribution, and lifecycle management.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics across:

+ Data Availability
+ Pipeline Throughput
+ Data Freshness
+ Data Accuracy
+ Data Completeness
+ Data Quality Scores
+ Operational SLA Compliance
+ Customer Adoption
+ Platform Reliability

* Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Data Governance teams to ensure alignment with enterprise policies and regulatory obligations.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational resilience, platform scalability, automation, and reduction of manual intervention.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for data quality, performance, and availability incidents.

**Product Delivery & Program Leadership**

* Lead cross-functional delivery initiatives spanning multiple data and technology organizations.
* Own product planning activities including:

+ Roadmaps
+ Business cases
+ Prioritization
+ Scope management
+ Release planning
+ Dependency management

* Facilitate Agile execution, Program Increment planning, roadmap reviews, stakeholder governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful delivery of data platform capabilities while balancing customer experience, operational excellence, security, and compliance requirements.
* Manage complex dependencies across ingestion, correction, storage, analytics, API, and fulfillment ecosystems.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate initiatives involving:

+ Enterprise Architecture
+ Data Architecture
+ Information Security
+ Regulatory & Compliance Teams
+ Data Governance
+ Analytics & Data Science
+ Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering
+ Application Development Teams
+ Business Product Owners
+ Operations & Support Organizations

* Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities.
* Influence enterprise-wide decisions regarding data architecture, governance frameworks, platform standards, and operating models.
* Act as the primary product leader for enterprise data platform capabilities and strategic modernization initiatives.

* 8+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, Technical Program Manager, Platform Product Manager, or equivalent leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, data products, ingestion services, or data management solutions.
* Experience defining and executing data platform strategy, roadmap development, adoption plans, and product lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems including:

+ Data Acquisition
+ Data Ingestion
+ Data Quality Management
+ Data Correction Workflows
+ Master Data Management
+ Data Distribution
+ Data Governance

* Experience working with both real-time and batch processing architectures.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture patterns including:

+ Event-driven architecture
+ Streaming platforms
+ Data pipelines
+ API-driven integrations
+ Data products

* Experience managing products supporting multiple internal and external customers.
* Experience establishing and reporting product KPIs and operational metrics.
* Proven ability to influence executive leadership, engineering organizations, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale, highly regulated, enterprise data initiatives.
* Strong ownership mindset with experience managing risks, dependencies, and commitments across multiple delivery teams.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Enterprise Data Platforms and Data Warehousing concepts.
* Data Ingestion Technologies including:

+ Kafka
+ CDC Platforms
+ Streaming Solutions
+ ETL/ELT Frameworks
+ Event-Driven Architectures

* Enterprise databases including:

+ PostgreSQL
+ SQL Server
+ Oracle
+ NoSQL Technologies

* Caching and low-latency data access platforms:

+ Redis
+ Distributed Caching Platforms
+ In-memory Data Technologies

* API Management and Data Services:

+ REST
+ gRPC
+ Event APIs
+ Data Service Layers

* Cloud platforms:

+ AWS
+ Azure
+ GCP

* Data Quality and Observability platforms.
* Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage concepts.
* Agile delivery tools including Jira, Confluence, and enterprise planning platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise credit, risk, fraud, identity, or financial data ecosystems.
* Knowledge of consumer, commercial, fraud, or alternative data acquisition and fulfilment processes.
* Experience with data correction and dispute management platforms.
* Experience with Data Mesh, Data Product, or Data-as-a-Service operating models.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks governing data management and consumer information.
* Experience leading enterprise data modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience presenting platform strategy, data quality trends, adoption metrics, and business outcomes to senior executive leadership.
* Strong understanding of data operations, service reliability, and operational excellence practices.

**TransUnion Overview**
At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our
**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.
  
  
TransUnion Job Title
  
  
Sr Consultant, Product Management

title: GRC Platform Delivery
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Platform Administration and Operational Support

· Build a working knowledge of the GRC platform, including its modules, workflows, user permissions, and underlying data structures.

· Provide operational support for the platform across various global risk and compliance processes.

· Investigate user-reported issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate escalations to the relevant teams.

· Assist with user access management, role assignments, permission updates, periodic access reviews, and onboarding activities.

· Develop and maintain platform-related documentation, operating procedures, user manuals, and knowledge resources.

2. Business Requirements and Delivery Coordination

· Engage with business, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business needs and gather functional requirements.

· Translate business requirements into structured documentation, including user stories, process maps, functional specifications, and configuration requirements.

· Review existing workflows and business processes to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and operational improvement.

· Monitor project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, action items, and implementation progress.

· Assist in coordinating delivery activities and ensuring requirements are clearly documented and aligned with stakeholder expectations.

3. Testing and Release Management Support

· Prepare and maintain test scenarios, test scripts, test cases, and expected outcomes for platform enhancements and changes.

· Conduct Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to verify that system functionality meets defined business requirements.

· Record test outcomes, identify defects, document observations, and track issues through resolution.

· Coordinate defect remediation, regression testing, retesting, and validation activities with relevant stakeholders.

· Support release preparation, deployment coordination, and post-implementation checks to confirm that changes have been delivered successfully.

4. Jira, Confluence, and Knowledge Management

· Create, update, and manage Jira tickets to track requirements, platform enhancements, defects, testing activities, and delivery progress.

· Maintain visibility into project tasks, dependencies, outstanding issues, decisions, and action items throughout the delivery lifecycle.

· Organize and update Confluence pages containing project documentation, meeting records, test evidence, release details, process flows, and user instructions.

· Ensure project and operational documentation is accurate, consistently maintained, and easily accessible to relevant stakeholders.

· Follow established documentation standards and support effective knowledge sharing across delivery teams.

5. Reporting, Data Analysis, and Quality Assurance

· Assist in preparing operational reports, performance dashboards, platform metrics, and management updates.

· Perform data quality checks, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain the accuracy and consistency of platform information.

· Analyze platform usage, workflow efficiency, recurring support issues, and operational performance indicators to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

· Extract, organize, and analyze relevant data to support risk management, compliance reporting, and platform-related initiatives.

· Contribute to reporting improvements and the development of reliable, data-driven insights for stakeholders.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration and User Enablement

· Support demonstrations of platform features, business workflows, and newly introduced functionality for relevant stakeholders.

· Assist in delivering user training, system walkthroughs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and platform adoption initiatives.

· Coordinate with regional and global teams to gather feedback, clarify requirements, and facilitate the timely completion of delivery activities.

· Prepare user communications, release announcements, quick-reference materials, and instructional guides to support platform changes.

· Help resolve user queries by providing guidance on platform functionality, documented procedures, and established support channels.

Experience- 2-5Yrs

Preferred- Immediate - 30days Joiner based out of Chennai

title: Engagement Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 200 passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $105M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Engagement Manager - US

**What will you do ?**

1. **Customer Engagement & Relationship Management:**
2. Act as a strategic advisor, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, executives, and cross-functional teams.
3. Drive engagement success by aligning customer goals with Rocketlane’s platform capabilities.
4. Ensure smooth onboarding and implementation, driving adoption and time-to-value.
5. **Project & Program Management:**
6. Lead and manage multiple customer implementations, ensuring on-time and within-budget delivery.
7. Establish clear project plans, track milestones, and proactively address risks and roadblocks.
8. Leverage Rocketlane and other PSA tools for project tracking, forecasting, and reporting.

**Process Optimization & Change Management:**

1. Identify and implement best practices to enhance customer onboarding and professional services delivery.
2. Drive process improvements that improve efficiency, scalability, and customer satisfaction.

**Strategic & Analytical Thinking:**

1. Utilize data-driven insights to optimize engagement strategies and enhance customer experience.
2. Work with internal teams to provide feedback, influence product enhancements, and refine service offerings.

**Customer Success & Retention:**

1. Collaborate with Customer Success teams to ensure continued value realization for customers.
2. Partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and contribute to business growth.

**Who We're Looking For:**

* Results-driven professional with
  **10+ years of experience**
  in project/program management, service delivery, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong customer-facing and executive communication skills, with a proven ability to build relationships internally and externally.
* Expertise in organizational and change management, balancing competing client demands while ensuring on-time, within-budget delivery.
* Proficient in project financials and PSA tools. Adept at navigating critical business situations with a customer-centric approach, strong interpersonal skills, and cultural awareness.
* Skilled in professional services metrics within a SaaS environment, with a background in
  **customer onboarding, implementation, and professional services automation (PSA).**
  Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments, fostering collaboration and adaptability.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**
  : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**
  : We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**
  : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**
  : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**
  : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: Coupa – Manager, Technical Transformation
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Coupa – Manager, Technical Transformation**
Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Manager, Coupa, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and support activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation and post-go-live activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Coupa on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting source-to-pay transformation initiatives across client environments.
  
  

* Lead discovery workshops, document business requirements, map current-state processes, identify process gaps, and design future-state workflows aligned to Coupa capabilities.
* Configure and support Coupa modules based on project scope, including Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, and Spend Analytics.
* Support integration design and execution between Coupa and enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, and Workday Financials, including connectors, flat-file integrations, and related data flows.
* Set up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, coding rules, supplier onboarding forms, and other components required for end-to-end source-to-pay operations.
* Support testing, defect triage, deployment, user training, hypercare, release updates, post-go-live optimization, and coordination with onsite and offshore teams across the implementation lifecycle.

**The team**
Enterprise Performance
  
  
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
  
  
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST, as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 9+ years of experience implementing or supporting Coupa across source-to-pay process areas, including requisitioning, sourcing, contracts, invoicing, supplier management, expenses, or payments
* Experience leading discovery workshops and documenting business requirements, process flows, and functional designs
* Experience configuring Coupa modules such as Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, or Spend Analytics
* Experience supporting integrations between Coupa and enterprise resource planning platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Workday Financials
* Experience setting up master data, catalogs, approval workflows, buying channels, and related configuration components within Coupa
* Experience supporting system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, deployment, or hypercare activities
* Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Master of Technology (MTech), or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience supporting procurement transformation, roadmap assessments, process re-engineering, or tool selection activities
* Experience with software-as-a-service procurement platforms such as Ivalua, SAP Ariba, or SAP Concur
* Experience supporting service-level agreement-based application support, ticket management, or root cause analysis
* Experience delivering training, user enablement materials, or software demonstrations for procurement platforms
* Experience supporting quarterly release management, upgrade planning, or post-go-live optimization
* Coupa or procurement platform certifications

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. The organizations focus on Off highways market, General Industries, Transportaion and Oil & Gas . In order to drive significant growth, while growing attack market and penetrating into new market segments such as Semicon, Data Centre, Life Science are imperative.

Utilize communication, interpersonal and influencing skills effectively with the regional and global organization and customers. Lead team by motivating all staff to move in a strategic direction and to work as a team to achieve the goal.
* Vision the future and provide strategic direction and insights into potential markets, prioritize opportunities, develop a strategic plan to approach the customers, and implement the strategy.

* 15+ years of experience as a senior manager in Sales and Operational leadership positions in the chemicals, Rubber, polymer or related industries
* Conversant with rubber product manufacturing process and machineries
* A Bachelor’s degree with a business or technical focus preferably Rubber or Polymer Engineering, Chemical and Mechanical Engineering
* Proven track record of identification, evaluation, and commercialization of new business opportunities with industrial customers.

title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology/Bio-Computing & AI
description:
**Job Title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**

**Experience:**
5–10 years of Experience with substantial hands-on experience in computational biology/bioinformatics, AI/ML, with demonstrated leadership of handling complex technical projects. Must have proficiency in Python/ relevant scientific computing & AI frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and associated data science libraries. Should be experienced with large-scale data processing, distributed computing, cloud-computing, GPU-based model training, or high-performance computing, DevOps & MLOps.

**Education: Ph.D**
. in Bioinformatics/Computational Biology/Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline with strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning models, and modern AI architectures.

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Research, Technology Product Development & AI Innovation

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly accomplished and visionary
**Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**
to lead the research, development, and deployment of innovative computational algorithms, large-scale machine learning models, and advanced artificial intelligence systems for multi-omics biological data.

The role will focus on building next-generation AI capabilities that integrate, analyze, and interpret complex, heterogeneous, and high-dimensional biological datasets, especially on
**multi-omics datasets and other molecular and clinical data modalities**
.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams in developing scalable AI/ML architectures, multimodal foundation models, predictive algorithms, and automated interpretation engines that transform complex biological data into clinically and scientifically meaningful insights. This position combines
**scientific innovation, AI/ML research leadership, computational platform development, and project/program management**
, requiring the ability to translate complex scientific challenges into robust, scalable, and impactful AI-driven solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI/ML Algorithm Development and Innovation**

* Lead the design and development of innovative computational algorithms and advanced machine learning models for biological data analysis, interpretation, and prediction.
* Develop novel approaches for extracting meaningful biological signals from complex, noisy, sparse, high-dimensional, and heterogeneous datasets.
* Drive research and implementation of deep learning, transformer-based architectures, graph neural networks, generative AI, self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, and other advanced AI methodologies.
* Establish methodologies for model training, predictive modelling, model optimization, validation, benchmarking, explanability and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate promising research into scalable computational solutions.

**2. Multi-Omics Integration & Multimodal AI**

* Lead the development of algorithms and AI models capable of integrating and interpreting diverse biological data types.
* Design advanced computational frameworks for cross-modal data integration, representation learning, feature extraction, and biological knowledge discovery.
* Develop unified or interoperable AI models that learn from multiple data modalities and generate integrated biological and clinical interpretations.
* Address challenges associated with missing modalities, batch effects, technical variability, data sparsity, population heterogeneity, and differences across platforms and experimental technologies.
* Explore the development of multimodal biological foundation models capable of learning generalizable representations across datasets, diseases, populations, and use cases.

**3. Large-Scale Machine Learning and AI Model Development**

* Architect, develop, and manage large-scale AI/ML models trained on extensive and diverse biological, molecular, clinical, and biomedical datasets.
* Lead the development of domain-specific foundation models, including models for biological sequence understanding, molecular representation learning, disease signatures, & integrated multi-omics interpretation.
* Build scalable data-processing and model-training pipelines to support large datasets, distributed computing, GPU-based workloads, and high-throughput analytical workflows; and optimize computational efficiency, inference performance, reproducibility, scalability, and deployment readiness..
* Develop reusable model architectures, training frameworks, feature libraries, and computational components that can be applied across multiple scientific and clinical applications.
* Establish strategies for pretraining, fine-tuning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, & continual model improvement.

**4. Automated Biological and Clinical Data Interpretation**

* Lead development of automated interpretation engines that convert raw or processed biological data into structured, actionable, and scientifically grounded insights.
* Build AI-driven workflows that integrate data quality assessment, feature extraction, model inference, evidence aggregation, interpretation, & report generation.
* Develop computational approaches for identifying disease-associated molecular patterns, clinically relevant biomarkers, molecular subtypes, & potential mechanisms of disease to enable automated interpretation across multiple use case.
* Incorporate biological knowledge bases, pathway databases, literature-derived evidence, and other curated knowledge resources to improve interpretability & contextual relevance.

**5. Computational Biology Research and Scientific Leadership**

* Define the computational biology & AI research roadmap in alignment with organizational scientific, product, and business objectives; and translate emerging scientific discoveries & computational methodologies into practical AI capabilities.
* Identify high-impact novel research opportunities at the intersection of systems biology, multi-omics, machine learning, & precision medicine and lead development of novel methodologies, algorithms, prototypes, & proof-of-concept systems.
* Critically evaluate scientific literature, benchmark emerging methods, and establish best practices for computational research; incorporate methodological innovation, reproducible research, & publication-quality analytical standards.
* Collaborate with domain experts to ensure that developed models capture meaningful biological relationships rather than relying solely on statistical associations.

**6. Project and Program Management**

* Own end-to-end execution of complex AI and computational biology projects, from problem definition and feasibility assessment through research, development, validation, and deployment.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, timelines, budgets, and measurable success criteria, and manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize initiatives based on scientific value, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and business impact.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising computational biologists, bioinformaticians, laboratory scientists, clinicians, and product teams.
* Establish effective project governance, risk management, technical reviews, and performance reporting processes. Anticipate scientific, data, computational, regulatory, operational risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery of robust, scalable, well-documented, and maintainable AI solutions.

**7. Data Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Platform Development**

* Guide the design of scalable data architectures and computational pipelines for the ingestion, harmonization, transformation, and analysis of multi-omics & clinical datasets.
* Oversee the development of robust workflows for data preprocessing, quality control, normalization, feature engineering, and metadata management.
* Establish model development, deployment practices covering experiment tracking, version control, automated testing, model registries, monitoring, & reproducibility.
* Operationalize research models within production-grade computational platforms, APIs, analytical applications, and automated reporting systems, and promote cloud-native and distributed computing architectures where appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate data security, access controls, privacy protections, and governance throughout the data and model lifecycle.

**8. Model Validation, Explainability, and Responsible AI**

* Establish rigorous validation frameworks to assess model accuracy, robustness, generalizability, reproducibility, and clinical or scientific utility.
* Design appropriate benchmarking strategies, independent test sets, external validation studies, & prospective evaluation approaches where feasible, and evaluate model performance.
* Develop interpretable AI methods that help scientists & clinicians understand model predictions and their supporting evidence.
* Implement uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution detection, bias assessment, & safeguards against unsupported interpretations.
* Work with clinical, quality, regulatory, and compliance teams to align development and validation practices with applicable requirements, particularly for intended clinical use.
* Ensure that models and automated interpretations are evaluated against defined acceptance criteria before operational deployment.

**9. Team Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams across computational biology, AI/ML research, bioinformatics, and data science and establish a culture of innovation, scientific integrity, technical excellence, collaboration, & accountability.
* Communicate scientific findings, technical strategies, project status, and business implications to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Translate broad scientific and clinical requirements into clearly defined computational problems, development roadmaps, and measurable deliverables.
* Build cross-functional alignment among research, clinical, product, and commercial teams, and manage collaborations with all external stakeholders, where required.

title: Chargebee - Senior Software Development Engineer - Revenue Story Modules
description:
**Job Description**
Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
  
  
Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Conde Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.
  
  
With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

You'll join the Revenue Story Modules team, a cross-functional group of engineers, product managers, and designers based primarily in India and collaborating with global stakeholders.
  
  
The team builds reporting, insights, and revenue intelligence capabilities that help customers understand and operationalize their subscription revenue performance.
  
  
We work closely with Platform, Billing, Support, and GTM teams to deliver scalable solutions with strong correctness guarantees, performance, and reliability.

Digital Product Managers at U. S. Bank are customer obsessed in defining and delivering the strategy and vision required for digital experiences to stay ahead of constantly evolving economic, competitive, technological, and customer needs. As a Digital Product Manager, you will:

* Ability to anticipate shifting market priorities, internal and external customer needs in a manner that consistently adds value
* Strong customer centricity to implement strategies and techniques used to ensure that customers have a positive experience with the organization's products and services at every touch point
* Knowledge of technical aspects of software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products
* Knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations
* Preferred skills: product PnL, product strategy, vision and planning, digital products and platforms, product discovery, product build and development, agile ways of working, channel alignment and management, adoption, customer experience research, insight and execution, go to market and sales channels, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics

* Actively engage with the Design and the Digital Acceleration teams to monitor and incorporate various needs and requirements, industry trends, and user feedback into the product.

* Develop product KPIs that are measurable, actionable, and aligned with business goals and users’ objectives.
* Actively monitor client needs, industry trends, Bank priorities, KPIs, and user feedback.

Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree in business, computer science, or a related field, combined with a minimum of 5 years product management experience, or bachelor’s degree with 7 years of product management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Strong understanding of business goals and the ability to translate them into product requirements.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in developing and operationalizing product strategies and managing the full product lifecycle.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and strong understanding of Agile planning tracking tools such as Azure DevOps.
* Proven track record of successfully developing and launching technology products in large-scale environments.
* Solid understanding of IT development lifecycles and methodologies.
* Proven ability to collaborate with other team members across boundaries and contribute productively to the team's work and output, demonstrating respect for different points of view.
* Able to use strong interpersonal and teamwork skills to cultivate effective and productive relationships and partnerships across organizational boundaries.
* Proven ability to define and track key performance indicators relevant to the product and the business goals.
* Mastering data analytics tools to measure client satisfaction, team velocity, and product metrics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, proficiency in creating concise reports, and presentations.
* Strong presentation and collaboration skills with proven record of leading meetings and influencing stakeholders in multicultural environments.
* Passion for innovation and staying up to date with the latest technology trends.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities.
* Able to take personal ownership and accountability to meet deadlines and achieve agreed-upon results and has the personal organization to do so.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant – Business Systems Analyst – Coupa
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Business Analysis Leadership: Apply business analysis techniques and lead delivery within a global S/4HANA Finance transformation, ensuring solutions align with clear business objectives.
* Finance Capability Design: Be responsible for the design of Finance capabilities, enable seamless delivery across releases, and lead solution remediation to protect process integrity and performance.
* SAP Best Practice and Architecture: Ensure compliance with SAP best practices, maintain integrated architecture standards, and implement robust, compliant data designs that endure.
* Planning and Risk Management: Assist in project planning, proactively handle risks and interdependencies, and keep delivery on time and on budget.
* Delivery Methodologies: Organise and implement project activities using Agile or Waterfall approaches, including SAP Activate, selecting the right tool for the outcome.
* Multi-functional Solution Design: Partner with the IT Design Team to produce solution designs that meet business and multi-functional requirements without fragmenting standards.
* Global Process Alignment: Engage with Enterprise Process Owners to define IT solutions that align to standardised global processes and deliver consistent outcomes.
* Finance Process Design and Integration: Lead Finance process design during global definition, ensuring deep integration with SAP solutions and related data objects.
* Standards Development and Testing: Develop and test global standard solutions, and bring designs through governance forums and frameworks to ensure adoption and quality.
* Product and Design Integration: Work with IT Business Analysts, Product Managers, and design experts to ensure global designs are coherent, scalable, and integrated.
* Innovation with External Experts: Collaborate with partner SME to bring the best of technology and standard approaches into our solutions.
* Strategic Design Forums: Participate in cross-functional design forums to align global designs with strategic business goals and system architecture.
* Localisation within Standards: Address localisation needs during deployment while safeguarding global standardisation and maintainability.
* Documentation and Enablement: Create clear solution designs, maintain high-quality project documentation, and deliver training on relevant tools and technologies.
* Coupa Solution and Process Expertise: Apply hands-on Coupa experience to analyse, design, and support Coupa-enabled procurement and invoicing capabilities integrated with SAP S/4HANA.
* P2P and Accounts Payable Process Leadership: Bring strong end-to-end business process understanding across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP), including requisitioning, purchasing, goods receipt, invoicing, matching, approvals, and payment-related dependencies.
* Coupa-to-SAP Data Mapping and Validation: Define, review, and validate Coupa versus SAP field mappings for master and transactional data; establish mapping rules, identify data gaps, reconcile interface outputs, and support defect resolution through SIT and UAT.

**Essential For The Role**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study or equivalent experience
* Experience applying business analysis tools, techniques, and concepts (e.g., requirements management, user-centered design, business process/product design) to deliver business change
* Experience collaborating with business partners to identify and address process/product requirements and IT needs
* Experience leading discussions, identifying and documenting business IT problem statements, business process/product design, and report requirements
* Experience working with third-party suppliers/vendors and supplier solutions/products
* Experience planning and handling resources and budgets within assigned areas
* Demonstrable hands-on experience working with Coupa, including procurement and invoicing processes and integration touchpoints with SAP.
* Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Accounts Payable (AP) business processes, controls, and data flows.
* Prior experience mapping Coupa fields to SAP fields for master and transactional data, with responsibility for data validation, reconciliation, interface testing, and defect analysis during SIT and UAT.

**Desirable for the Role**

* Certification in business analysis practice (preferred)
* Experience in advising business partners across one or more functional domains within the pharmaceutical industry;
* Experience in effectively communicating with and influencing individuals at various levels (e.g., peers, managers, team members)
* Experience working within a global matrix organization, including geographically dispersed teams and partners.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. title: Product Manager
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build voice AI agents for field service businesses. These agents need to do more than hold a conversation. They need to understand customer needs, take the right actions and complete tasks reliably over the phone.

You’ll own inbound and outbound calling experiences, working closely with customers, engineering and design from discovery through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll own

* Customer discovery and product direction: understand how businesses handle calls, identify opportunities and prioritise the workflows that deliver the most value.
* Agent behaviour: experiment with prompts, models and conversation flows. Review call recordings and transcripts to understand failures and improve the experience.
* Integrations: work with engineering and other business-system integrations, including tool calling, missing information and failed actions.
* Quality and evaluations: define test scenarios and success criteria for real-world conversations, including ambiguous requests, interruptions, incorrect answers and unsuccessful actions. Validate changes before rollout and monitor performance after launch.
* Outcomes and adoption: track task completion, booking accuracy, handoff quality, response latency, reliability, cost per successful interaction and customer adoption.

What we’re looking for

* 4+ years of product management experience, including hands-on experience shipping and improving AI or conversational products in production.
* Experience translating customer problems into clear requirements, priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Practical understanding of how speech-to-text, LLMs and text-to-speech work together, and how agents use knowledge sources, tools and APIs.
* Familiarity with voice-specific challenges such as turn-taking, interruptions, latency, accents and background noise.
* Experience with prompt/model experimentation, evaluations and using customer conversations to guide product decisions.
* Good judgment on quality, speed and cost trade-offs, including when an agent should clarify, retry or hand over to a person.
* Confidence leading customer conversations and demos, explaining product limitations and working with customers through adoption.

This is a product role with technical depth. You should be comfortable working through problems with engineering and staying close to how the agent performs in real customer conversations.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
****Senior Product Manager, Platform****
**What We're Looking For**
We're seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join the Presentment value stream within Arcadia's Utility Data Platform (UDP) pillar. Presentment owns the customer-facing layer of the utility data pipeline, Plug, UDS, DELI, and DICE, that lets customers and downstream systems manage, retrieve, and consume utility data. This person will help define and drive product requirements for Plug's presentment capabilities — the APIs, delivery workflows, and customer-facing tools that make Arcadia's unified data model usable at scale — partnering closely with the Presentment product lead, who sets overall roadmap direction.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between an API spec, a front-end wireframe review, and a cloud architecture discussion, and can turn distinct customer and downstream-team needs into a coherent, well-documented presentment layer. This person should be comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to boost their own and their team's productivity.
****Note: this is not an AI-native product role****
— the mandate is data presentment and delivery, not building AI/ML product features.
  
  
The Presentment engineering team consists of 10+ engineers and 2 engineering managers, split across the US and India. This person will collaborate frequently with engineering (India and US), other Presentment and UDP product leads, and cross-functional teams like Customer Success and Operations to ensure the success of their product. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, detail-oriented, and a systems thinker who enjoys breaking complex problems into smaller steps that drive iterative delivery, and who can build and execute roadmaps while coordinating cross-team dependencies to completion.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Drive execution of the Plug presentment roadmap — the customer-facing APIs and interfaces that deliver utility data to internal and external consumers.
* Define, prioritize, and ship features that scale Plug across new and existing customer use cases.
* Partner with engineering to evolve the data delivery architecture, including cloud infrastructure (AWS) decisions that affect scale, reliability, and cost.
* Define and maintain clear, well-documented API contracts and specifications for downstream teams and external partners consuming Plug data.
* Collaborate with front-end engineering and design on customer-facing tools (delivery configuration, status/breadcrumb visibility, self-serve workflows).
* Partner with upstream Extraction, Auditing & Storage (EAS) teams to ensure presentment changes stay aligned with the canonical unified data model.
* Write clear product requirements and specs that are easily understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Own day-to-day management of KTLO and balance run-the-business work and tech-debt reduction against new capability delivery, including evaluating where AI can reduce run-the-business load (without shifting the role's core mandate to AI product work).
* Use AI tools to improve personal and team productivity, and model good AI-assisted workflows for the squad.
* Monitor and communicate progress on initiatives to stakeholders and the leadership team.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with peers in Engineering, Operations, and other UDP value streams (Acquisition, EAS) to deliver on time.
* Contribute to public-facing API documentation (docs.arcadia.com) so external partners and customers can self-serve integration with Plug.

**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must-Haves****

* 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time on cloud-based SaaS or data platform products.
* Solid data management fundamentals: familiarity with data models, storage systems (e.g., Snowflake), and how data moves through acquisition, storage, and delivery layers.
* Experience partnering with front-end engineering and design on customer-facing product surfaces (dashboards, configuration tools, self-serve workflows).
* Proven experience defining and documenting APIs, contracts, versioning, and developer-facing documentation, for consumption by multiple downstream teams or external partners.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and how architecture choices affect product scale, reliability, and cost.
* Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to increase personal and team productivity.
* Comfort with ambiguity and iterative delivery in a fast-changing environment.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams across time zones (India/US).
* Demonstrated experience aligning and influencing cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineering and business audiences.

****Nice-to-Haves****

* Experience in energy, utilities, or fintech/expense-management software.
* Experience with legacy-to-modern platform migrations or system consolidation (relevant to the ongoing UDS → Plug migration).
* Experience with developer-facing APIs/SDKs or API-first product strategy.
* Experience with data governance, master data management, or data cataloging tools.
* Background in a regulated vertical (energy, finance, telecom, healthcare).

**Benefits**
****Compensation & Benefits****

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits


+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.
  
  
Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The team works across refurbishment, trade-in, buyback, asset recovery, and responsible disposition programs to build a scalable, partner-led business while extending the life of technology assets.

The
**Manager – Product Management**
will be responsible for driving the growth, profitability, and execution of the Redington Recommerce business. The role will own the professionally refurbished device portfolio, pricing and commercial strategy, inventory planning, supply ecosystem, partner programs, and go-to-market initiatives.

The role will work closely with territory and inside sales teams to build a scalable partner-led business and develop trade-in, buyback, asset recovery, and ITAD programs to strengthen future supply.

**Who We’re Looking For:**

We are looking for a commercially driven and analytical product management professional with experience in technology hardware, IT distribution, category management, refurbished devices, or technology lifecycle services. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in portfolio management, pricing, profitability, inventory planning, demand forecasting, and go-to-market execution.

The candidate should be comfortable working with channel partners and cross-functional teams and should have a strong understanding of market trends, commercial performance, and business growth opportunities.

**Your Role:**

• Establish portfolio priorities, market positioning, revenue plans, profitability objectives, and go-to-market actions

• Identify demand trends, configuration gaps, relevant price points, partner segments, and market opportunities

• Maintain a portfolio roadmap covering models, specifications, product grades, warranty propositions, and new offerings

• Track revenue, gross profit, margin, sell-through, inventory ageing, and working capital performance

• Monitor market pricing and competitive movements to maintain a relevant and profitable partner proposition

• Recommend corrective actions for slow-moving inventory, product mix, pricing gaps, promotions, and margin performance

**Inventory & Supply Planning:**

• Coordinate with procurement, supply, operations, finance, and refurbishment teams to maintain the right product mix and availability

• Develop scalable supply routes through trade-in, buyback, asset recovery, and ITAD programs to strengthen future inventory supply

**Partner Programs & Sales Enablement:**

• Develop partner propositions, launch plans, incentive programs, campaigns, promotions, and activation initiatives

• Enable territory and inside sales teams with product knowledge, pricing, inventory updates, positioning, objection handling, and competitive inputs

• Conduct sales and partner training, portfolio reviews, and periodic business reviews to improve activation and conversion

• Work closely with marketing and sales teams to increase visibility, partner engagement, enquiry generation, and order conversion

**Business Operations & Governance:**

• Prepare forecasts, dashboards, monthly business reviews, and leadership updates covering commercial, inventory, pipeline, and program performance

• Coordinate with sales, finance, credit, legal, procurement, operations, logistics, technology, and other stakeholders to scale the business

• Improve operating processes for pricing, stock reporting, order flow, partner communication, warranty support, business reporting, and program execution

• Ensure portfolio and partner programs operate within approved commercial, compliance, legal, and governance requirements

**You’re the Right Fit If You:**

• Have a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, Technology, or a related discipline; an MBA would be an advantage

• Have approximately
**6–10 years of experience**
in product management, category management, IT distribution, hardware business, professionally refurbished devices, or technology lifecycle services

• Have strong experience in pricing, profitability, inventory management, business planning, demand forecasting, and go-to-market programs

• Have experience working with channel partners and cross-functional teams in a distribution-led environment

• Have strong analytical skills and proficiency in spreadsheets, business reporting, commercial reviews, and management presentations

• Demonstrate strong business acumen with the ability to translate market insights into actionable business strategies

**Core Competencies:**

• Product and portfolio management

• Pricing and commercial management

• Business planning and profitability management

**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
WPP is accelerating the adoption of AI across the enterprise, investing in a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to transform how work gets done across our global business.
  
  
Within Enterprise Technology, we're enabling this transformation by building the platforms, capabilities and operating models that will power the next generation of work. From Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation to emerging AI technologies and agentic workflows, we're embedding AI into the fabric of how WPP operates globally.

description:
**Shape Enterprise Construction Data Architecture as a Product Manager – Common Data Environment (CDE)**
Are you a systems-and-customer thinker who excels at turning complex data integration layers into seamless, intuitive user experiences? Trimble is seeking a technically fluent Senior Product Manager to own how enterprise customers bring their data into
**Trimble Connect**
—and how they experience, structure, and govern that data once it arrives. As construction data multiplies across global tools and project teams, you will play a central role in driving the platform that connects the right people to the right data at the right time.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is an industrial technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. In support of Trimble's Connect and Scale strategy and the Trimble Connected Construction vision, Trimble Connect serves as the open collaboration backbone for millions of users worldwide. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**Our Product Ecosystem:**
Trimble Connect is our central Common Data Environment (CDE) and cloud collaboration platform. It breaks down data silos across the entire Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations (AECO) lifecycle, enabling informed decision-making and open project collaboration.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this high-impact position, you will own Connect's data-experience and CDE data domain end-to-end. You will partner directly with senior engineering leaders who build deep technical layers, weighing architectural trade-offs where product strategy and platform architecture intersect. You will have full ownership over building application-layer AI capabilities—such as AI-assisted metadata, automated classification, and smart import mapping—while acting as an industry thought leader representing Trimble across globally distributed customer networks.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Product Definition & Strategic Roadmap: Transform a fragmented set of data capabilities and integrations into a coherent, highly differentiated product narrative tied directly to Trimble Connect's global growth strategy.
* AI-Forward Data Experience: Design and deploy modern application-layer AI features within the data experience, including AI-assisted metadata generation, automated file classification, and smart import mapping.
* Technical & Architectural Leadership: Partner closely with senior engineering leaders on platform requirements, leveraging deep technical fluency to weigh architecture trade-offs across data models, authorization frameworks, and APIs.
* Customer Engagement & Market Insights: Conduct direct strategic discovery with key users and C-level customer executives to uncover actionable operational insights and validate platform capabilities.
* Product Evangelism & Thought Leadership: Represent Trimble Connect as an industry thought leader at major forums, elevating our market credibility across the global construction ecosystem.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Lead and align cross-functional, globally distributed teams, translating complex data analysis and business goals into clear, executable product milestones.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Product Management Track Record: 5+ years of direct experience operating as a platform Product Manager with a referenceable history of delivering impactful B2B software products.
* Technical & Architectural Fluency: High technical literacy with the ability to discuss complex system trade-offs alongside senior engineers—including comfort with enterprise data models, APIs, SaaS mechanics, and tiered authorization protocols.
* Systems & Customer Thinking: Exceptional ability to conceptualize complex software ecosystems and synthesize fragmented integrations into a unified, user-friendly platform experience.
* Stakeholder Influence & Communication: Outstanding communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with a proven track record of influencing senior leadership and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline).

**Bonus Points For**

* Construction Tech Domain Expertise: Direct experience within construction technology or a closely adjacent enterprise B2B software domain.
* CDE & AEC Product Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Common Data Environments (CDE), collaboration tools, or spatial/BIM data management products in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.
* AI Integration: Hands-on experience defining or launching AI/ML-assisted features within enterprise SaaS platforms.

**Logistics**

* Department: AECO Platform
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

**How to Apply:**
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

* Risk, Controls and Design Governance: Embeds risk and control considerations into requirements and solution design, establishes clear decision records and traceability, and ensures appropriate governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Benefits and Outcome Focus: Defines measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, links requirements to intended benefits and uses evidence to confirm that delivered solutions address the original business need.

**Additional Skills**

* Business English and Multinational Experience: Highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working with global stakeholders; experience supporting United Kingdom-based teams is highly desirable. Experience in Human Resources, Workday or process transformation environments is also desirable.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Lead Through Ambiguity: Provides structure and direction in complex or uncertain situations, makes sound decisions with incomplete information and maintains momentum while key issues are resolved.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Leads virtual and cross-functional teams through discovery, design and validation activities, clarifying accountabilities and creating an environment in which challenge and collaboration are encouraged.
* Decision Facilitation and Conflict Resolution: Surfaces trade-offs, resolves competing priorities and facilitates timely decisions, escalating material risks or unresolved issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Coaching and Capability Building: Coaches analysts and delivery colleagues, sets quality standards, provides constructive feedback and shares practical methods that strengthen requirements and process analysis capability.
* Executive Communication: Communicates complex information in a concise and compelling way, tailoring messages for senior audiences and presenting clear insights, impacts, recommendations and decisions required.
* Accountability for Delivery Quality: Sets expectations for quality, pace and governance, monitors progress and intervenes early to address gaps, ensuring requirements remain coherent, testable and aligned to agreed outcomes.

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

You may be assessed on critical reasoning, business analysis, requirements management, process mapping, stakeholder engagement, change and transformation, risk and controls, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology skills. Assessment may include a process-flow exercise or case-study discussion focused on gathering requirements, structuring delivery activities, managing stakeholders and supporting project execution.
  
  
This role will primarily be based in Chennai, India, with Pune accepted as a secondary location.
  
  
Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.
  
  
  

* Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.

* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.

* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
