* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. * We embrace the challenges of a fast paced market and evolving technologies and making decisions to provide the best buying experience to our customers.
* You will be encouraged to see the big picture, be innovative, and positively impact millions of customers.
* Successful candidates for this position will have a background in Java or C++. Equally important to these specific skills is a candidate's ability to multi-task, adapt quickly to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, gain new skills, create reliable & maintainable code, and find creative, scalable solutions to difficult problems.
* The ability to communicate clearly and concisely both written and orally is a key competency as is demonstrable skill as a self-starter.

Our vision is to enable a zero-friction purchase experience, offering all payment methods for Books customers worldwide on any surface

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
* 2+ years of server-side development experience
* 3+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

* Translate Vision into Action: Deconstruct complex business requirements into well-defined Epics, User Stories, and precise Acceptance Criteria, ensuring a high percentage of stories are accepted without rework.
* Drive Sprint Success: Serve as the dedicated point of contact for the engineering team, providing unwavering clarity during sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and throughout the development cycle to remove ambiguity.
* Solution Definition & Quality Assurance

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

DeeVita is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, roadmap and delivery of our regulatory compliance software products and services for the pharmaceutical industry, spanning digital labelling, serialization and track-and-trace, and supply chain traceability. You will work directly with global pharma clients, translating complex regulatory requirements and industry standards such as GS1, DSCSA, EU FMD, ePI and GxP into validated, scalable products. You will partner closely with engineering, QA and validation teams, and with client stakeholders in regulatory affairs, quality and supply chain, from discovery through release.

We are a team of talented, collaborative engineers who are passionate about making a difference in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry. Join us to help shape how medicines are labeled, tracked and safely delivered to patients worldwide, using modern technology in a fast-paced, supportive environment.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Program Management**

* Work with cross functional teams across the client organization spread worldwide spanning regulatory, business, partners, engineering, clinical trials, labelling, etc. to drive program objectives end to end from inception to delivery
* Monitor evolving global regulations and guidance from health authorities (US FDA, EMA, CDSCO and others) and convert them into product requirements and roadmap priorities.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization through effective communication, excellence in subject matter expertise and systems knowledge to plan, design and deliver programs and systems objectives that create greater impact for clients
* Act as the primary product contact for global pharma clients (US, EU and other regions), leading requirement workshops, product demos and roadmap reviews.
* Communicate product status, release plans, risks and decisions clearly to internal leadership and client stakeholders.
* Collaborate with client-side regulatory affairs, quality, supply chain and IT teams, as well as technology partners and vendors where applicable.
* Ensure data privacy and security requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA where applicable) are built into product design, in collaboration with IT and security teams.

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the product vision, roadmap and prioritized backlog for pharma regulatory compliance solutions across digital labeling, serialization, traceability and supply chain.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research to define product features, differentiation and release plans.
* Define product success metrics (client adoption, regulatory coverage, release quality, time-to-compliance) and track outcomes after release.

**Regulatory Compliance & GxP**

* Translate regulatory requirements into clear PRDs, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, with end-to-end traceability from requirement to test (Requirements Traceability Matrix).
* Ensure products are designed and released as GxP-compliant systems in line with 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11 and GAMP 5 (CSV / CSA), including audit trails, electronic signatures, role-based access and data integrity (ALCOA+).
* Partner with QA and validation teams on validation deliverables such as URS, FS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ and validation summary reports, and support client audits and vendor qualification.
* Embed industry standards into product design, including GS1 (GTIN, GLN, SSCC, GS1 DataMatrix, EPCIS) and structured product information standards (HL7 FHIR ePI, ISO IDMP, FDA SPL).

**Delivery & Execution**

* Drive Agile delivery with engineering and QA, including sprint planning, backlog refinement and release planning, aligned with formal change control for validated releases.
* Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies across workstreams; drive timely mitigation and escalation.
* Ensure quality gates (testing, UAT, validation sign-off) are met before every release goes live.
* Drive Agile delivery with engineering and QA, including sprint planning, backlog refinement and release planning, aligned with formal change control for validated releases.
* Identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies across workstreams; drive timely mitigation and escalation.
* Ensure quality gates (testing, UAT, validation sign-off) are met before every release goes live.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in software product management or product ownership, including at least 3 years in the pharma or life sciences industry
* Hands-on experience building or managing regulatory compliance systems in one or more of the following areas: digital labeling / ePI, labeling and artwork management, regulatory information management, serialization, track-and-trace, or pharma supply chain.
* Working knowledge of GS1 standards and at least one major traceability regulation, such as US DSCSA, EU Falsified Medicines Directive (FMD), or India's DGFT / CDSCO track-and-trace and QR code requirements.
* Experience delivering GxP-compliant applications, with working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5 and computer system validation (CSV / CSA).
* Proven experience working directly with global clients (preferably US / EU) in client-facing product or delivery roles.
* Excellent English communication skills across listening, reading, writing and speaking, with the confidence to present to senior client stakeholders from different cultural and language backgrounds
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams (engineering, QA, validation, business) simultaneously.
* Strong experience with Agile / Scrum and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps and Confluence; ability to write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of structured content and regulatory data standards such as HL7 FHIR (ePI), ISO IDMP, FDA SPL and EMA SPOR / PMS.
* Exposure to labeling workflows and documents (CCDS, USPI, EU SmPC / PIL) or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) platforms such as Veeva Vault.
* Experience with serialization and traceability platforms (e.g., TraceLink, SAP ATTP, rfxcel, Antares Vision, Optel) and EPCIS-based data exchange.
* Familiarity with ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management) and ICH Q10, or with ISO 13485 and UDI requirements for medical devices and combination products.
* Experience with AI / ML-enabled features in regulatory, labeling or supply chain workflows.
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or PMI-ACP.

**Benefits:**

* Industry-competitive compensation package.
* Opportunity to build products at the intersection of technology and pharma regulation, used by global clients.
* Opportunity to work global pharmaceutical challenges with major clients and excellent career growth across product, domain and leadership tracks
* Paid time off (EL, SL, CL) and health insurance coverage.
* Flexible Hybrid work arrangements

**About Us:**

 

DeeVita is a dynamic and growing organization that has provided advanced technology services and solutions to enterprise customers in the USA for over a decade. DeeVita specializes in data, analytics, AI and cloud solutions, along with product development services for clients ranging from startups to large enterprises, with a deeper focus in healthcare and pharma & life sciences industry.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
OptiSol Business Solutions & O2V Private Limited Looking for AI Product Manager

**AI Product Manager:**
Supply Chain & Procurement · Chennai (Hybrid) · 5–8 years

**Role: AI**
Product Manager — Supply Chain & Procurement

**Product:**
elsai (elsai.ai) — OptiSol’s enterprise AI agent platform

**Experience:**
5–8 years, with at least 3 in product management for a B2B software product

**Location:**
Chennai — hybrid, 3 days a week in office

**Reports to:**
CEO, OptiSol

**Travel:**
Customer sites across India; occasional overlap hours for international accounts

**About elsai**

elsai is OptiSol’s enterprise AI agent platform. It sits on top of the systems an enterprise already runs — it does not replace them — and gives business teams agents that execute real work under governance: human-in-the-loop gates bound to the stage of the workflow, evidence and a confidence score behind every recommendation, override-with-reason recorded, and a full audit trail of what the agent did and what the human changed. It runs in our cloud, in a customer VPC, or on-premise with open-weight models when data cannot leave.

We are building depth in two verticals: Healthcare, and Supply Chain & Procurement. This role owns the second one.

**Why this role exists**

Over the past year we have run more than a dozen enterprise procurement engagements across manufacturing, metals, EPC, aerospace and process industries. The positioning lands. The proof is what is missing. Procurement heads keep asking the same things — configure our approval matrix and delegation of power, track what happens after the award, connect to the ERP we already run, show me what the agent did versus what my team did — and we keep answering them one deal at a time instead of once, in the product. The other objection we hear, in almost the same words each time, is that the product is too heavy and shows too much. That is not a polish problem either.

We need one person who sits with those customers, hears the same requirement for the third time, and turns it into a platform capability instead of another custom configuration. That person writes the spec, defends the cut, and stands in front of the customer when it ships. That is this job.

**This is a build-and-sell-and-build role.**
Roughly half your week is customer-facing: discovery, demos, debriefs, replaying real procurement cycles through the product. The other half is product work: briefs, acceptance criteria, prioritisation, sitting with engineering. If you want only one of those halves, this is not the role.

**What you will own**

**1. Customer connect — be in the room, not downstream of it**

* Run discovery and demo sessions with Heads of Procurement, Supply Chain and Materials directly. You should be able to hold that room without a sales engineer beside you.
* Write the note from every session against one fixed theme taxonomy, so that fifteen conversations produce a count, not fifteen anecdotes.
* Own the customer-voice loop end to end for this vertical: listen, count how many accounts asked for a thing, decide what that means for the roadmap, ship it, and go back and tell them.
* Keep the record straight. Every engagement gets a CRM entry with the real stage. Without a denominator we cannot tell nine accounts from one loud one.
* Run a structured win/loss review after every demo cycle, and be willing to write the qualification finding nobody wants to hear — including “this customer’s process is not broken enough to buy.”

**2. The supply-chain agent portfolio**

* Own the roadmap for our procurement agents — supplier risk, contract and obligation management, tender and bid evaluation, BOM and specification handling, document drafting — from brief through prototype to a shipped, priced product.
* Mark every agent honestly as live, in build, or roadmap. We do not demo designs as delivered.
* Design for composition, not a flat catalogue. Where one agent consumes another’s output, that dependency is our best proof the platform is real — make it visible.
* Push generalisable requirements into the platform and keep customer-specific logic out of the core. The third time we hand-build the same configuration, it becomes a feature.

**3. Product UX — make the agent usable by the person who actually does the job**

Our most repeated objection is not accuracy. It is that there is too much on the screen. A buyer raising an indent, an approver clearing a value band on a phone between meetings, and a supplier who touches our system once a quarter are three different users with three different tolerances — and today they largely get the same dense interface. Simplifying that is a product decision and it is owned in this role. It is not a visual clean-up handed to design at the end.

* Define the interaction model role by role — buyer and category manager, approver in the delegation-of-power chain, materials and planning, contract owner, finance, and the external supplier — and cut each default surface to what that person needs in order to act. Where a simpler industry needs a third of the complexity of the heaviest one, that is an architecture decision made once, by policy, not renegotiated in every deal.
* Minimise what a human has to type, above all on the supplier side. An external supplier has no reason to learn our system, and every field we add is a reason not to respond.
* Design the approval experience for how approvals actually happen — in a queue, often on a phone, between other things — with the recommendation, the evidence behind it and the override path visible in a single glance.
* Make the agent’s reasoning legible, not merely present. Wherever we show a confidence score, a risk number or a ranking, the user must be able to see how it was arrived at without asking us. “How is that calculated?” is a question we get in the room and cannot yet answer inside the product.
* Design the unhappy path with as much care as the happy one: what a person sees when the agent is unsure, what they see when they disagree, how they say so, and what the system does with that disagreement afterwards.
* Write the flows, sit in usability sessions with real procurement users, and defend the cut when a stakeholder asks to put one more field back on the screen. You will be paired with a designer and will not be doing the craft work alone — but the interaction model is yours, and you are accountable for it.

**4. Prototype with AI tools — argue with something a customer can click**

We expect this role to use AI tools to think. A rough, clickable prototype of a screen or a flow, produced in an afternoon, settles an argument that three rounds of written debate will not — and put in front of a procurement head on the second call, it turns a vague discussion into specific feedback. The standard we care about is speed to a testable idea, not craft; the designer takes it from there.

* Use AI prototyping and generation tools fluently to produce clickable mockups, concept screens and pitch visuals — whichever tools you prefer, and whatever replaces them next year. We care that you reach for them by reflex, not which logo is on them.
* Take a prototype into a customer conversation rather than a slide, and treat what happens in that conversation as the real requirement-gathering.
* Use the same tools to pitch internally: make the idea visible to engineering, design and leadership before anyone commits a sprint to it.
* Know what a prototype is not. It is a question you are asking, not a specification and not a commitment — so it never becomes the demo, and it never goes to a customer labelled as something we have built.

**5. Translate procurement reality into platform requirements**

* Approval chains, delegation-of-power matrices, value bands, payment-term variants and mid-cycle changes — turn these into configuration a customer administrator can change without a release, not into hard-coded logic.
* Post-award tracking, SLAs, escalation and delay attribution: who caused the delay — the agent, the internal team, or the counterparty. Specify the primitive, not a one-off report.
* Specify the business rules as declarative, versioned, testable policy, so an auditor can see the rule, its version, and every run it fired on.
* Own the integration requirement: define and drive one live ERP round trip as a reference customers can verify, and specify connector health as a product surface rather than a support conversation.

**6. Evidence, pricing and packaging**

* Define the efficiency benchmark a buyer will accept — cost, cycle time and effort against the customer’s own baseline — and make sure the number we publish is the same number everywhere.
* Contribute to packaging: a module list a buyer can price, and a first engagement small enough to say yes to.
* Gate releases against a simple test: can a customer verify this claim without us in the room? If not, it is not

**What we are looking for**

**Must have**

* 5–8 years of experience, with at least 3 years as a product manager on a B2B enterprise software or SaaS product that real customers paid for.
* Genuine domain fluency in procurement or supply chain: source-to-contract and procure-to-pay, RFQ and tender cycles, vendor onboarding and risk, approval matrices and delegation of power, contracts and obligations, PO/GRN/invoice matching. You have either built for this domain or worked inside it.
* Hands-on product experience with AI/ML or LLM-based features shipped to production — agents, retrieval, evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, confidence and hallucination controls, prompt and version management. Practitioner understanding, not vocabulary.
* Working knowledge of enterprise ERP landscapes (SAP, Oracle, Ariba, Coupa or equivalent) and what integrating with them actually costs.
* A record of simplifying enterprise software rather than only adding to it. Point us at a workflow you cut down — fewer screens, fewer fields, fewer decisions demanded of the user — and tell us what you removed, what it cost, and how you knew. Wireframe-level fluency and the confidence to run a usability session yourself. You will be paired with a designer, so we are not asking you to be one.
* Fluency with AI tools as part of how you work — prototyping and generation tools to get to a clickable screen or a concept pitch in hours rather than a sprint. Bring an example to the interview. We do not mind which tools; we do mind whether reaching for them is a habit.
* Strong customer-facing presence: you can run discovery with a senior procurement leader, take an objection live, and come back with a written point of view.
* You write clearly and often. Briefs, acceptance criteria and meeting notes are the artefacts of this job, and vague ones cost us weeks.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with saying no. Much of this role is deciding what we will not build.

**Good to have**

* Time spent inside manufacturing, EPC, metals, energy or aerospace — or consulting into them.
* Experience with on-premise or VPC enterprise deployments, data residency requirements and enterprise security reviews.
* Exposure to open-weight models, model routing, and the accuracy/latency/cost trade-offs between them.
* Prior work on workflow, approval or rules-configuration engines.
* Experience designing for infrequent, non-technical, external users — supplier portals, vendor onboarding, self-service — where there is one attempt and no training.
* Experience designing AI or recommendation interfaces where trust, explanation and override are the design problem rather than a footnote.
* Experience selling or supporting a platform to both business buyers and enterprise IT — they are different audiences and need different arguments.

**Who this role is not for**

* Someone who wants to administer a backlog that other people fill.
* Someone who wants to be a full-time presenter, or a full-time writer of specs, but not both.
* Someone who treats user experience as design’s problem and product’s afterthought.
* Someone who needs a mature product, a settled roadmap and a research team upstream. None of those exist yet — building them is the job.

**How we will interview**

* Introductory conversation on your background and why this problem interests you. (30 min)
* Domain and product discussion: walk us through a procurement or supply-chain workflow you know well, and where an agent should and should not sit in it. (60 min)
* Take-home exercise: a short product brief for one capability, from a real anonymised customer requirement we will share — plus a rough prototype or concept screen of how the person who has to use it experiences it. Use any AI tool you like; we expect you to. We read for judgement, clarity and how fast you got to something we could react to — not for polish or length.
* Customer simulation: run a discovery conversation with one of us playing a Head of Procurement. (45 min)
* Closing conversation with leadership on ways of working, ownership and compensation.

**What we offer**

* Direct ownership of a vertical at the point where it converts from demos to revenue, reporting to the CEO, with direct access to customers and to every decision that affects the product.
* A platform and an engineering team already in production, so your specs ship rather than queue — and a designer paired with you on the experience.
* Hybrid working from Chennai, three days a week in office.

title: Business Relationship Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Business Relationship Manager**
**Overview**
The Business Relationship Manager serves as the primary link between the AI team and business units across the organization. The role is responsible for gathering business requirements, prioritizing AI initiatives, supporting technology rollouts, and ensuring successful adoption and business value of AI solutions.
  
  
The role will work closely with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and Learning & Development to drive adoption, track usage and satisfaction, and address adoption risks.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Own and maintain relationships with business unit stakeholders across the organization, serving as their primary point of contact for AI team engagement.
* Gather business requirements and user needs, translating them into prioritized, well-scoped inputs for the engineering team.
* Define, track, and report on adoption and usage metrics for deployed AI solutions — not just delivery status.
* Design and execute change communication and rollout plans for phased deployments, partnering with Learning & Development on training hand-off.
* Serve as the escalation point for business-unit feedback and concerns regarding AI tooling and automations.
* Identify early signals of adoption risk and drive corrective action before they surface as broader dissatisfaction.
* Facilitate prioritization discussions, bringing business context and stakeholder impact to bear on engineering roadmap decisions.
* Report adoption outcomes, business value, and stakeholder sentiment to executive leadership.
* Build and maintain a repeatable framework for onboarding new business units onto AI-enabled workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience in business relationship management, stakeholder management, product management, customer success, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience driving adoption of new technology or business processes.
* Experience defining and tracking adoption, usage, or satisfaction metrics.
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with technical/engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and limitations.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience in financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, or emerging technology rollouts.
* Experience managing relationships across multiple departments.
* Change management certification such as Prosci ADKAR or CCMP.
* Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA.
* Product/program management certification such as PMP or CSPO.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Product Manager, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Delivery of a connected consumer grooming ecosystem covering mobile apps, IoT devices, firmware, BLE connectivity and cloud services. The role takes Epics approved by Product Management and turns them into User Stories, Acceptance Criteria and a sprint-ready backlog for distributed dev teams. Product Management keeps ownership of strategy, scope, priorities and final acceptance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain and prioritise the delivery backlog under approved Epics, keeping items implementation-ready
* Write and refine User Stories, Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done, with traceability to requirements and releases
* Manage dependencies across mobile, firmware, hardware, BLE, cloud and UX
* Support sprint planning, refinement and release planning, and escalate risks early
* Coordinate PSAT (Privacy, Security, Accessibility, Third-Party) compliance items with the Maintenance Leader
* Act as the main delivery contact between Product Management, mobile, firmware, UX/UI, QA and partners
* Maintain Jira and Confluence documentation (release notes, functional specs)
* Track delivery progress and risks, and report status and corrective actions to Product Management
* Escalate changes affecting scope, priority, budget, compliance or release approval to the Product Manager

**Requirements**

* 5+ years as Product Owner, Product Manager or Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum
* Strong Jira and Confluence experience, with proven Epic-to-Story/Acceptance Criteria decomposition
* Hands-on software development background and delivered IoT integrations
* Solid understanding of end-to-end mobile architecture: APIs, cloud, data flows, security, BLE, connected devices, firmware
* Strong requirements engineering, stakeholder communication and distributed team collaboration
* Fluent written and spoken English
* Desired: connected-product delivery experience, including mobile UX specs and Figma

**What’s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About Us**
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Senior PMM (IC3)
description:
**About Everstage Inc.**
Everstage is the leading sales compensation and SPM platform. We automate commissions, quota and capacity planning, territory design, and real-time payout visibility for sales teams globally.
  
  
We're heading into the most exciting chapter of our story so far, a global brand refresh is about to go live, the leadership team is showing up more publicly and gaining followers and we want our social channels to feel less like a corporate handle and more like a creator brand.
  
  
That's where you come in.
  
  
**About The Role**
Everstage is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market for major launches across our revenue platform: Everstage Incentives, Everstage Planning, and Everstage CPQ. You will own product storytelling and differentiation for your product areas, run projects end to end, and be accountable for launch impact. You will work directly with senior leaders in Product, Sales, and Customer Success, and help shape how customers experience and advocate for Everstage.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own GTM strategy for major product launches, from positioning and messaging through sales enablement, launch campaigns, and post-launch measurement.
* Lead product storytelling and differentiation, including how we position our AI capabilities against how buyers run incentives, quoting, and planning today.
* Develop market segmentation and narrative for key buyer personas: RevOps leaders, Sales Ops, Finance, and sales reps.
* Synthesize customer insights, competitive analysis, and market trends into sharper positioning, and bring those insights into roadmap conversations with Product leadership.
* Lead multi-format content campaigns across web, email, social, events, and sales enablement.
* Build sales tools that win deals: pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection handling for competitive situations.
* Build and grow Everstage's customer marketing program: launch and manage a customer reference program, turn customer wins into case studies and video testimonials with measurable outcomes, grow our presence on peer review sites, recruit customers to speak at webinars and events, and set up structured feedback channels, such as customer interviews and advisory board sessions, that feed messaging and roadmap decisions.
* Influence cross-functional peers and leadership on launch priorities, timing, and success metrics.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years of product marketing experience in enterprise or technical B2B SaaS.
* Experience in Sales Performance Management (SPM), Incentive Compensation Management (ICM), or Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ). You know how RevOps, Sales Ops, and Finance teams buy and use these tools.
* Exceptional writing skills. You can take a complex concept and turn it into a clear, simple copy a busy RevOps leader understands in one read.
* Experience marketing AI products or AI-powered features, and a working knowledge of how buyers evaluate AI in enterprise software.
* A track record of owning major launches end to end, with results you can point to. You know how to bring Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing together around one plan and keep them aligned through launch day and beyond.
* Deep technical acumen. You can learn a complex product quickly and explain it in plain language tied to a business outcome.
* Comfort working with senior stakeholders and managing projects autonomously.
* Experience building and growing a customer marketing program is preferred. Ideally you have launched a reference program, shipped case studies and video testimonials, or run a customer advisory board, and you can show how that work helped Sales win deals.

title: Frontier Foundation Lead
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**
This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level:
**Drive our business strategy**
and inspire teams around our future.
**Live the leadership behaviors**
, leading themselves, others and the business.
**Uphold our Values**
, role modeling them in every action and decision.
**Nurture our people and culture**
, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Frontier Foundation Lead, you will make an impact by building the reusable intellectual capital of the Frontier Capability Unit (FCU) - the offerings, methodologies, accelerators, tools and assets that give SEG's AI-native engagement model its edge - and taking that capital to market and into client delivery. You will be a valued member of the Frontier Capability Unit team and work collaboratively with SEG Solutioning, GSA, the IDU and Frontier Talent community, hyperscaler and model partners, industry analysts, and clients.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the offering and accelerator roadmap across Agentic Coding & ADLC, Autonomous Agents & Runtime and Vertical Solutions, including domain and hyperscaler-specific offerings, and sponsor the Garage / R&D build of new assets and proof points ahead of client demand.
* Build and maintain delivery kits, composable tooling (MCP & Skills), delivery methodology and pod-design patterns consumed by the IDU and the Frontier Talent community, owning their availability and quality.
* Own the asset / IP register for the unit and the Enterprise Runtime & Governance standard that assets must meet before they are published for re-use.
* Supply estimation models, productivity guidance and Assurance & Evaluation proof points into new and vendor-consolidation deals, and co-create bid support with SEG Solutioning / GSA.
* Own hyperscaler, model-partner (Anthropic, Google / Gemini, OpenAI) and Agentic Trust & Security ecosystem relationships and represent the FCU's capability to industry analysts.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* 20+ years in IT services, with 10+ years in AI-native / GenAI engineering, solutioning or offering & IP leadership.
* Strong technical / solutioning grounding in AI-native and GenAI engineering, credible enough to set an offering roadmap and engage architects and partners.
* A proven track record of taking IP to market through pre-sales support, accelerator build, and analyst / partner engagement.
* Experience building estimation and proof-point models for bids.
* A builder-evangelist profile with market-facing scope, able to lead a direct and indirect span of 20-30 across pillar-aligned focus areas.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**These will help you succeed**

* Working knowledge of major model and cloud ecosystems — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google / Gemini, Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and determine enterprise readiness.
* Experience designing reference architectures, engineering standards and delivery patterns.
* Strong market-sensing skills that convert frontier technology trends into a forward offering roadmap.
* Experience industrialising reusable offerings, accelerators and methodologies that differentiate at scale.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Frontier Transformation Lead, you will make an impact by building the reusable intellectual capital of the Frontier Capability Unit (FCU) - the offerings, methodologies, accelerators, tools and assets that give SEG's AI-native engagement model its edge - and taking that capital to market and into client delivery. You will be a valued member of the Frontier Capability Unit team and work collaboratively with SEG Solutioning, GSA, the IDU and Frontier Talent community, hyperscaler and model partners, industry analysts, and clients.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the offering and accelerator roadmap across Agentic Coding & ADLC, Autonomous Agents & Runtime and Vertical Solutions, including domain and hyperscaler-specific offerings, and sponsor the Garage / R&D build of new assets and proof points ahead of client demand.
* Build and maintain delivery kits, composable tooling (MCP & Skills), delivery methodology and pod-design patterns consumed by the IDU and the Frontier Talent community, owning their availability and quality.
* Own the asset / IP register for the unit and the Enterprise Runtime & Governance standard that assets must meet before they are published for re-use.
* Supply estimation models, productivity guidance and Assurance & Evaluation proof points into new and vendor-consolidation deals, and co-create bid support with SEG Solutioning / GSA.
* Own hyperscaler, model-partner (Anthropic, Google / Gemini, OpenAI) and Agentic Trust & Security ecosystem relationships and represent the FCU's capability to industry analysts.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* 20+ years in IT services, with 10+ years in AI-native / GenAI engineering, solutioning or offering & IP leadership.
* Strong technical / solutioning grounding in AI-native and GenAI engineering, credible enough to set an offering roadmap and engage architects and partners.
* A proven track record of taking IP to market through pre-sales support, accelerator build, and analyst / partner engagement.
* Experience building estimation and proof-point models for bids and connecting offerings to commercial outcomes such as TCV and pricing-to-win.
* A builder-evangelist profile with market-facing scope, able to lead a direct and indirect span of 20-30 across pillar-aligned focus areas.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**These will help you succeed**

* Working knowledge of major model and cloud ecosystems — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google / Gemini, Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and determine enterprise readiness.
* Experience designing reference architectures, engineering standards and delivery patterns.
* Strong market-sensing skills that convert frontier technology trends into a forward offering roadmap.
* Experience industrialising reusable offerings, accelerators and methodologies that differentiate at scale.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Business Process Expert  - Travel & Expenses
description:
Job Title
  
  
Business Process Expert - Travel & Expenses
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Responsibilities:**
The Business Process Expert is responsible for ensuring best-in-class Philips’ business capabilities within the Travel & Expenses (T&E) domain, with full accountability for the design, governance, and continuous improvement of the end-to-end travel expense process. This includes expense submission, audit, settlement, and compliance with the global travel policy and internal control framework.
  
  
The role requires deep expertise in SAP Concur and strong understanding of SAP ERP integrations and related upstream/downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow, system integrity, and compliant execution of T&E processes.
  
  
The BPE is responsible for designing and maintaining detailed end-to-end process flows, driving standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions.
  
  
With a strong continuous improvement and simplification mindset, the role applies industry best practices (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Agile) to enhance process efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve employee experience. The BPE actively identifies optimization opportunities, including automation and digitalization within the T&E landscape.
  
  
The role plays a key part in governance and change management by:
  
  

* Coordinating and aligning with IT development teams on system enhancements and integrations
* Defining, reviewing, and approving business requirements
* Ensuring high-quality execution and validation of System Integration Testing (SIT)
* Maintaining strict attention to detail to ensure compliance with audit and control requirements

In addition, the BPE is responsible for enabling operational excellence by training and supporting operational teams, ensuring consistent understanding and execution of T&E processes, policies, and tools.
  
  
The role also requires solid knowledge of automated T&E audit solutions (e.g., AI-driven audit tools) and their application in strengthening compliance and control effectiveness.
  
  

* Contributes in defining a wide range of moderate complexity business capability that represents voice of customer, Business Units, Regions, Functions, regulators, and other key stakeholders for both shared and standard processes and in defining the minimum standard for a process and hand-over strategy to BUs/Regions for guided flexible processes.
* Provides guidance in creating Fit-For-Purpose E2E moderate complexity process by modelling in the Process Framework and ensures alignment with the supporting IT applications, data model and job families incl. relevant process KPI’s and compliance controls for standard and shared processes.
* Provides support in designing the minimum level of standard for a process and hand-over to BUs/Regions, including Process Guardrails for guided flexible processes.
* Works closely with the product owners and Local Process Owner/Expert (LPO/E) to ensure the design is accurately reflected in the IT solutions.
* Contributes to IT solution development projects and in software validation process, developing testing scenarios as part of UAT and validation (as appropriate) to ensure the business capabilities can be executed by the target user group.
* Handles change management, business go-live readiness (including trainings) and Process readiness in local MS/QMS during the deploy phase for standard and shared processes, monitoring of the capability during deployment particularly as part of lead deployment to ensure all elements of the design work as expected and incorporate feedback into the capability and training design before mass deployment.
* Aids in ensuring deployment of minimum level of standard processes to BU/Region, including process guardrails for guided flexible processes.
* Assists in establishing an accurate capability performance and adoption reporting in their domain, with reference to relevant targets.
* Provides support in applying industry best practices such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Agile to enhance efficiency of business capabilities.
* Helps to capture learnings and actively shares success within community.

**Minimum Required Education**
Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations, Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Minimum Required Experience**
Experience in applicable functional domain, in combination with Project Management, Change Management, Lean Manufacturing.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a T&E-related Business Process Expert, or IT Development or T&E leadership role (including end to end coordination of Travel & Expenses operations and problem solving)
* Strong expertise in SAP Concur and understanding of integrations with SAP ERP and related systems
* Experience working with automated T&E audit/monitoring tools
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including coordination with IT development teams, Business Team and senior stakeholders
* High level of attention to detail, particularly in reviewing requirements and approving testing outcomes
* Experience in T&E IT development or system implementation is considered an asset
* Experience in designing end-to-end process flows and driving process improvements is considered as an asset

**Preferred Certification**
Lean Six Sigma
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Business Acumen
* KPI Monitoring and Reporting
* Data Management
* Regulatory Compliance
* Stakeholder Management
* Continuous Improvement
* Project Management
* Training Delivery
* Change Management
* Process Management
* Systems Integration
* Technical Acumen

IT project management
  
  
**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  
  
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
**About Philips**
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  
  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
description:
**About Pearson**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple:
**Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

  
  

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher-value work while accelerating business transformation.

  
  

The
**Office of the CTO**
powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital & Technology (D&T), the
**AgentOps Team**
leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.

  
  

**Why Join AgentOps?**

  
  

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.

  
  

You will:

  

  
* Build cutting-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
  
  
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
  
  
* Solve high-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
  
  
* Influence enterprise-wide AI engineering and automation standards
  
  
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly
  

  

**Role Overview**

  
  

The
**Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations**
is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end-to-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.

  
  

As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.

  
  

You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**Business Analysis & Opportunity Discovery**

  

  
* Lead end-to-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
  
  
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI-driven workflow transformation.
  
  
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
  
  
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.
  
  
* Translate business challenges into scalable AI and automation solutions with clearly defined value realization metrics.
  
  
* Establish measurable ROI, productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost optimization objectives.
  

  

**Solution Design & Agentic Architecture**

  

  
* Design intelligent workflows, multi-agent systems, and semi-autonomous business processes.
  
  
* Define agent behaviors, orchestration patterns, decision frameworks, escalation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
* Create comprehensive solution artifacts including:
  
  
* Process Design Documents (PDDs)
  
  
* Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
  
  
* User Journeys
  
  
* Process Flows
  
  
* System Interaction Diagrams
  
  
* Agent Behavior Models
  
  
* Data & Integration Specifications
  
  
* Partner with architects and engineering teams to establish scalable and reusable design patterns.
  
  
* Ensure solutions align with enterprise platform, integration, security, and governance standards.
  

  

**Agentic AI & Automation Delivery**

  

  
* Lead the functional design and implementation of agentic automation solutions.
  
  
* Collaborate with developers, AI engineers, and automation specialists throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
* Design workflows incorporating:
  
  
* Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents
  
  
* Human review and approval stages
  
  
* Escalation paths
  
  
* Exception handling
  
  
* Feedback loops
  
  
* Continuous learning mechanisms
  
  
* Drive adoption of reusable components, templates, skills, prompts, and accelerators across initiatives.
  
  
* Support enterprise rollout, change management, and operational readiness activities.
  

  

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

  

  
* Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership.
  
  
* Communicate solution vision, business value, risks, and implementation approaches to executive and technical audiences.
  
  
* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
  
* Mentor team members and promote best practices in agentic automation delivery.
  

  

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

  

  
* Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson's Responsible AI framework.
  
  
* Implement controls to mitigate:
  
  
* Hallucination risks
  
  
* Prompt injection attacks
  
  
* Data leakage
  
  
* Model misuse
  
  
* Compliance and privacy risks
  
  
* Apply governance requirements based on solution risk levels including low, medium, and high-stakes use cases.
  
  
* Support auditability, explainability, transparency, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  
  
* Partner with security, legal, privacy, and risk teams to ensure enterprise readiness.
  

  

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

  

  
* Partner with program and project managers to ensure successful execution and delivery.
  
  
* Define and track success metrics including:
  
  
* Productivity improvements
  
  
* Cost reduction and avoidance
  
  
* Time savings
  
  
* Automation utilization
  
  
* Employee experience improvements
  
  
* Customer experience outcomes
  
  
* Ensure solutions integrate with enterprise observability, monitoring, telemetry, and governance platforms.
  
  
* Drive continuous optimization through performance measurement and feedback.
  

  

**Innovation & Capability Building**

  

  
* Contribute to Pearson's AgentOps roadmap and enterprise AI strategy.
  
  
* Create and maintain reusable assets including:
  
  
* Prompt libraries
  
  
* Agent templates
  
  
* Automation accelerators
  
  
* Design standards
  
  
* Playbooks and frameworks
  
  
* Evaluate emerging AI, agentic, and automation technologies.
  
  
* Champion an agentic-first mindset and culture of continuous learning across the organization.
  

  

**Technology Ecosystem**

  
  

**Agentic AI & Large Language Models**

  

  
* Azure OpenAI
  
  
* OpenAI APIs
  
  
* Claude
  
  
* Enterprise AI Platforms
  
  
* Multi-Agent Frameworks
  

  

**Automation & Orchestration**

  

  
* UiPath Studio
  
  
* UiPath Orchestrator
  
  
* UiPath Agent Builder
  
  
* UiPath Document Understanding
  
  
* Microsoft Power Automate
  

  

**Data, Integration & Enterprise Platforms**

  

  
* REST APIs
  
  
* JSON / XML
  
  
* OAuth
  
  
* Salesforce
  
  
* ServiceNow
  
  
* Oracle
  
  
* BigQuery
  
  
* OCR & Intelligent Document Processing
  

  

**Engineering & Development**

  

  
* Python
  
  
* JavaScript
  
  
* SQL
  
  
* Git & Version Control
  
  
* AI-Assisted Development Tools (Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

**Education**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
* Master's degree preferred but not required.
  

  

**Experience**

  

  
* 8+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, automation, AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional automation and AI initiatives.
  
  
* Strong experience conducting discovery workshops and translating business requirements into technology solutions.
  
  
* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through automation, AI, or enterprise transformation programs.
  

  

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

  
  

Deep understanding of:

  

  
* Agentic AI and autonomous systems
  
  
* Intelligent process automation
  
  
* Enterprise integration patterns
  
  
* Human-in-the-loop workflow design
  
  
* AI governance and Responsible AI principles
  
  
* Enterprise architecture frameworks
  
  
* Business process analysis and optimization
  
  
* Risk management, compliance, and security requirements
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

  

  
* Strategic thinking and problem solving
  
  
* Exceptional stakeholder management
  
  
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
  
  
* Executive presence and influence
  
  
* Decision-making under ambiguity
  
  
* Collaboration across global and cross-functional teams
  
  
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset
  

  

**Success Measures**

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by:

  

  
* Enterprise adoption of agentic automation solutions
  
  
* Measurable productivity and efficiency gains
  
  
* ROI realization from automation investments
  
  
* Delivery quality and stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
* Reusability and scalability of solutions
  
  
* Compliance with Responsible AI and governance standards
  
  
* Contribution to Pearson's AI and automation transformation agenda
  

  

**Pearson is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where innovation thrives and every employee can contribute to shaping the future of learning through AI and technology.**

  
  

**Join us in building the future of work, where humans and intelligent agents collaborate to create extraordinary outcomes.**

  
  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

  
  

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

  
  

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Enterprise Technology**
plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are
  
  
In this position...
  
  
As the Salesforce Technical Product Manager in Global CRM team, you will own the technical delivery roadmap for our Ford Integrated Services products revenue-generating tools . You will act as the strategic link between our Sales, Marketing, and Operations stakeholders and engineering teams.
  
  
We are seeking a strategic leader who excels in navigating high-ambiguity environments and can translate abstract visions into the concrete technical requirements needed to build "0 to 1" solutions from inception to launch. Beyond managing core Sales and Marketing Clouds, you will spearhead complex data flows between Salesforce and our in-house enterprise data lakes. As a forward-thinking platform owner, you will actively foster innovation by identifying, setting up, and steering Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate emerging technologies and optimize our tech stack.
  
  
Based in Chennai, this is a hybrid position with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week.
  
  
Looking for 9+ years of IT experience, including at least 5+ years as a Product Manager, Technical Product Owner in a Salesforce environment
  
  
**Product Strategy & Backlog**

* Own, prioritize, and groom the product backlog, translating business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery plan.
* Align quarterly features with commercial and revenue goals while balancing technical debt, infrastructure maintenance, and architecture improvements.
* Lead Program Increment planning and coordinate dependencies across teams.

**Agile Delivery & Release Management**

* Partner with diverse stakeholders to clarify unstructured or ambiguous needs and shape them into structured technical blueprints and prioritized epics.
* Translate business requests into detailed technical specifications, user stories, architecture diagrams, and clear acceptance criteria
* Lead cross-functional engineering teams using Scrum, Kanban, and established SDLC practices.
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives in an enterprise agile environment.
* Coordinate release cycles and user acceptance testing (UAT); validate releases, troubleshoot production issues, and support reliable delivery.
* Promote sound DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control, and enterprise release management.

**Salesforce Architecture & Governance**

* Collaborate with Salesforce Architects to assess design trade-offs, including configuration versus customization.
* Apply practical knowledge of Salesforce data modeling, security and sharing rules, Flows, reporting dashboards, and developer workflows.

**Innovation & AI**

* Identify opportunities for Proofs of Concept (PoCs) using Salesforce features, AppExchange packages, and modern automation frameworks.
* Define strategies for AI-enabled solutions, including predictive analytics and process automation using Salesforce Agentforce frameworks.
* Monitor Salesforce releases and evaluate capabilities such as Data Cloud, AI/Einstein, Flow enhancements, IVI, and WhatsApp to address business needs.

**Service Improvement & Reliability**

* Experience coordinating UAT, validating releases, troubleshooting production issues, and improving quality and reliability
* Apply incident, problem, change, release, and service-level management practices.
* Lead root cause analysis, track corrective actions, and drive continuous improvements in quality and reliability.
* Independently manage day-to-day priorities, escalate risks appropriately, and follow through on delivery and issue resolution

**Salesforce Domain Expertise & Tools**

* In-depth knowledge of Salesforce products and capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and Agentforce
* Practical understanding of Salesforce data modeling, security and sharing rules, Flows, reporting dashboards, and developer workflows
* Strong command of Scrum, Kanban, Jira, Confluence and enterprise release management tools
* Understanding of event-driven architectures, REST and SOAP APIs, and data deduplication methodologies

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Stakeholder management: Communicate technical constraints clearly to non-technical business leaders and explain business needs to technical teams.
* Influence without authority: Align engineering resources and lead cross-functional transformation efforts.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Act as a liaison among business product managers, enterprise architects, peer product teams, legal, data engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Mentorship: Guide junior Product Managers, and peers on Salesforce best practices, execution strategy, and product management methods
* Feature advocacy: Stay current with Salesforce releases and identify capabilities that can solve business problems or create new opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
* 5+ years of working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with tools like JIRA/Rally
* Deep understanding CRM/Salesforce architecture (Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Multi-tenancy, Mulesoft APIs/Integrations, Agentforce, batch data ingestion, etc.
* 9+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on the Salesforce/CRM ecosystem

Even better, you may have
  
  

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate the ‘how’ and ‘why’ behind technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences. You can navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and build consensus around platform priorities
* Salesforce Certifications: Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant, Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Agile Certified Professional (PMI-ACP) are a significant plus
* DevOps Knowledge or experience with Salesforce DX and automated testing frameworks (e.g., Copado, Jenkins)

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.
* Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability.
* Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred.
* Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring.
* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
* Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Feature Store, Gemini or other foundation-model platforms, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building reusable enterprise platforms and underlying services for data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Experience with forecasting, supply chain, order fulfillment, demand planning, optimization, or decision intelligence products.
* Ability to translate product roadmaps into manageable features through quarterly scoping sessions and assist product teams directly with technical blockers.
* Proven ability to identify and mitigate delivery, data, model, security, adoption, and operational risks while assessing overall product health and prompting timely decisions.
* Strong understanding of business priorities and technical feasibility to prioritize platform backlogs and manage dependencies.
* Experience with Lean methodology, eXtreme Programming (XP), Agile product management, and Human-Centered Design.
* Experience championing modern software, data, AI/ML, product, and responsible AI practices within a large organization.
