title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary – AI Technical Lead.**

* Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced
  **AI**
  **Lead (Technical)**
  to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its
  **Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain.**

* The role will drive innovation in
  **Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform**
  .

* The candidate will
  **provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers**
  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

* The role requires strong hands-on
  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain & Solutioning Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the TPM/RGM domain authority across Cognizant’s Consumer Goods practice — designing end-to-end solution architectures covering trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, deduction management, and RGM analytics.
* Lead client solution design workshops and discovery sessions, driving alignment between business objectives (volume, margin, trade ROI) and platform capabilities.

Pre-Sales & Bid Support
  
  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses as the primary TPM/RGM domain voice — authoring solution narratives, effort models, and PoC demonstrations for Salesforce CG Cloud and XTEL engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams on pursuit strategy and competitive positioning; build and maintain reusable solution accelerators, proposal templates, and reference architectures.

Thought Leadership & Practice Development
  
  

* Publish whitepapers, point-of-view papers, and industry blogs on TPM/RGM trends, platform innovations, and CPG commercial technology; represent Cognizant at conferences and speaking engagements.
* Build and contribute to Cognizant’s TPM/RGM CoE — defining best practices, developing delivery playbooks and reusable assets, and mentoring junior consultants within the Consumer Goods practice.

Alliance & Partnership Management
  
  

* Serve as Cognizant’s primary relationship manager with key TPM/RGM platform partners — Salesforce CG Cloud, XTEL, and relevant ISVs — nurturing joint GTM engagement, co-sell pipeline, and aligned solution roadmaps.
* Track partner roadmaps and identify partnership opportunities with CPG ecosystem players (o9, Anaplan, BluePlanner) to extend Cognizant’s TPM/RGM service portfolio; develop joint collateral and partner sales plays.

Industry Forum Participation & External Engagement
  
  

* Represent Cognizant at CPG technology conferences and industry forums (Salesforce Consumer Goods Summit, CGT events, XTEL user groups); deliver presentations and panel discussions on trade transformation and AI-driven RGM.
* Engage analyst communities (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) to position Cognizant’s capabilities; build an external professional network across CPG trade marketing and technology communities to generate leads and surface new service opportunities.

Techno-Functional Lead — Customer Project Support
  
  

* Serve as senior functional advisor on select engagements — providing domain expertise during blueprint, fit-gap, and go-live phases without owning day-to-day workstream delivery.
* Act as the functional escalation point for delivery teams — resolving complex design decisions and conducting periodic quality reviews of solution documents and test plans.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
Domain & Technical Skills
  
  

* Deep functional expertise in TPM (trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, settlement, deduction management, post-event analytics) and RGM (pricing strategy, pack-price architecture, mix management, net revenue optimization).
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (primary) — account planning, fund configuration, promotion lifecycle, deduction management, and MuleSoft integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference) — trade fund setup, promotion planning, claims processing, and SAP/Oracle ERP integration architecture.
* Experience on at least 2 full-cycle TPM/RGM implementations; proficiency in delivery artifacts (BRDs, fit-gap documents, configuration workbooks, UAT scripts) and platform partner/alliance engagement.

Pre-Sales & Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills — able to influence VP/Director-level stakeholders; proven track record contributing to and winning CPG/Consumer Goods RFPs.
* Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills; ability to translate business challenges into platform solutions and produce high-quality proposals, PoVs, and solution collateral.

title: Implementation Senior Analyst

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Title:**
Delivery Lead

**Location:**
Only Chennai- Hybrid(4 days/week). Not open for other locations at this point

**Duration:**
Full time

**Notice period:**
Immediate to 60 days max

**Budget:**
Open to discuss

⚠️ Important Note

**Please do not apply if you have interviewed with Mastech Digital within the past 3 months.**
Duplicate/recent interview profiles may not be considered for this opportunity.

**Role Summary**

*The Delivery Lead (known as Delivery Manager in other organizations) sits between the Delivery Partner and Project Manager in the delivery hierarchy — owning end-to-end delivery of Data & Analytics programs for one or more client accounts, depending on account size, and ensuring governance, quality, and strong client stakeholder relationships. This is a generic role deployed across verticals; specific vertical experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.*

**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of D&A programs for one or more client accounts, scaling scope with account size and complexity
* Drive program planning, execution tracking, and milestone management across owned accounts
* Embed standardized delivery and automation practices across each account

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact for delivery matters on owned accounts
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and proactively manage expectations
* Lead delivery governance forums (status reviews, steering committees) with client leadership

**Governance, Quality & Risk**

* Ensure delivery governance and quality standards are met across engagements
* Proactively identify delivery risks and drive mitigation and escalation as needed
* Deliver scalable, insight-driven solutions aligned to client business outcomes

**Team & Project Management Oversight**

* Direct and mentor Project Managers/project leads within owned accounts, providing delivery direction beyond single-project execution
* Manage delivery estimation, staffing, and financial performance for assigned accounts
* Track utilization, billing milestones, and margin across owned accounts
* Escalate portfolio-level risks, resourcing gaps, or growth opportunities to the Delivery Partner where applicable

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* Strong delivery management experience on analytics/D&A projects
* Client-facing experience with senior stakeholders
* Working knowledge of cloud data ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP data platforms)
* Solid grounding in delivery governance, estimation, and financial management
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery ownership, not just program oversight
* Experience directing or mentoring Project Managers, or a track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams/accounts

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Domain experience in Financial Services & Payments (FSP) — e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, Basel, banking/payments data ecosystems — is a plus
* Domain experience in Healthcare — e.g., HIPAA, HL7/FHIR, payer/provider analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Retail — e.g., merchandising, supply chain, or customer/loyalty analytics — is a plus
* Domain experience in Manufacturing — e.g., Industry 4.0, IoT/OT data, supply chain or quality analytics — is a plus
* PMP, Agile/Scrum, or Scaled Agile (SAFe) certification
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP data or analytics track)
* Experience with delivery reporting/tooling (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Power BI, Tableau)

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field
* 12–18 years of overall experience, including meaningful experience managing and delivering analytics/D&A projects, with hands-on client-facing delivery ownership

**Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months**

* Strong client relationship established; delivery predictability visibly improved
* Account governance cadences (steering committee, status reporting) fully operational
* Standardized delivery practices and playbooks embedded across owned account(s)

**\*\*\*Profiles We Are Not looking at This Point\*\*\***

* Pure PMO or BI-developer profiles without delivery ownership
* Profiles without hands-on delivery ownership or client interfacing experience
* No prior exposure to Data & Analytics engagements

description:

**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications

title: Lead Delivery Manager
description:

title: AVP, Engineering Lead, WRB Tech
description:
**Job Summary**
The Engineering Lead is a senior technology delivery professional responsible for driving the successful end-to-end delivery of complex products and features. This role provides technical leadership across multiple squads, ensures engineering excellence, and partners closely with Product, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to meet strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Lead and support the formulation of technology strategy across the product domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business priorities
* Drive ownership of the product-suite strategy alongside Product Owners and Business stakeholders, ensuring prioritization and alignment with delivery outcomes
* Shape technology roadmaps, architectural direction, and long-term engineering plans to support sustainable delivery
* Oversee and contribute to budgeting, demand planning, and resource forecasting for engineering needs, ensuring transparent reporting and trade-off discussions
* Ensure consistency of solutions within the domain and alignment to broader enterprise technology standards

**Business**

* Champion engineering excellence and implement best-practice delivery methods across squads, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes
* Partner with Business, Product, and Architecture leads to translate business needs into feasible delivery plans and scalable technical solutions
* Promote an environment of innovation, encouraging teams to leverage modern engineering patterns and tools to solve business challenges
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering practices, delivery processes, and technical operations
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture standards and support long-term technology sustainability
* Foster strong cross-functional collaboration, providing leadership that reinforces accountability, ownership, and engineering craftsmanship

**Process**

* Oversee and continuously refine engineering processes to ensure efficient, predictable, and transparent delivery across all squads
* Enable timely and quality delivery of releases by ensuring disciplined sprint planning, dependency management, and effective removal of blockers
* Drive adoption of standardized eSDLC practices and ensure compliance with architectural, security, and operational guidelines
* Identify and implement improvements in engineering effectiveness, tooling, automation, and ways of working to maximize squad efficiency
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of delivery metrics, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders
* Manage relationships and performance of technology vendors, ensuring value and alignment to engineering expectations
* Promote best practices in data management and governance to support reliable product delivery
* Guides engineering quality by defining evaluation criteria, enforcing best-practice AI tooling, and validating technical user stories, fixes, and core functionality enhancements.

**People & Talent**

* Take on Chapter Leadership as an active practitioner in the craft of the Chapter that they lead, i.e., has full accountability to the growth of the Chapter, and not solely a line management responsibility.
* Provide strong leadership to engineering teams, fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and high performance
* Actively engage in mentoring and capability uplift, strengthening technical skills, delivery discipline, and career development across squads
* Support hiring, onboarding, and talent development to build a resilient and skilled engineering workforce
* Promote a safe, inclusive, and collaborative environment, enabling teams to innovate and deliver their best work
* Ensure engineering teams adhere to craftsmanship principles and maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and design
* Optimizes AI knowledge reuse and consumption by identifying reusable capabilities and uplifting engineering skills across the hive.

**Risk Management**

* Identify, manage, and mitigate delivery risks and issues proactively, ensuring timely escalation and resolution
* Ensure squads adopt appropriate testing, code reviews, security controls, and architecture governance practices
* Maintain strict adherence to eSDLC processes, ensuring high-quality engineering outputs and predictable delivery
* Promote safe delivery through proper documentation, change management, and quality assurance practices

**Governance**

* Address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements through the delivery lifecycle (design reviews, security reviews, SAT, OAT, etc.) with support from HTL(Hive Tech Lead) / PO / CPO (Chief Product Owner)
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, operational, and enterprise governance standards across all engineering work
* Support audits, oversight reviews, and risk committees with accurate and timely reporting
* Drive adherence to engineering governance frameworks, including architecture governance, risk controls, security requirements, and delivery standards
* Contribute to and participate in governance forums to represent engineering delivery health, risks, and strategic needs
* Evaluates & refines AI-generated requirements / technical artefacts, ensuring strategic alignment, feasibility, & adherence to standards.

**Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years experinece in software engineering
* Java & Back-end Engineering Strong hands-on Java engineering experience, with a solid understanding of modern Java, Spring/Spring Boot, concurrency, application performance, dependency management, and building maintainable enterprise back-end services.
* API & Service Development Strong experience designing, building and evolving REST APIs and service-based architectures. Able to make good decisions around API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorisation, error handling, idempotency, resilience, observability and backward compatibility.
* Database Engineering Strong relational database fundamentals, including data modelling, SQL, transactions, indexing, query optimisation and performance troubleshooting. Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle is preferred, but strong experience with comparable enterprise relational databases is acceptable.
* Systems Design & ArchitectureAble to design scalable, resilient and secure distributed systems, and reason about service boundaries, integration patterns, synchronous versus asynchronous processing, caching, failure handling, high availability and performance.
* Security Engineering Fundamentals Strong understanding of secure application development, particularly API security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, secrets management, dependency vulnerabilities and common application/API security risks such as the OWASP Top 10.
* Engineering Quality & Testing Strong understanding of automated testing across unit, integration, contract and end-to-end levels, with the ability to establish appropriate quality controls within CI/CD pipelines.
* DevOps & Production Engineering Practical experience with CI/CD, containers, deployment automation, monitoring, logging and troubleshooting production services. Able to design software with operability and production resilience in mind.
* AI-Augmented Engineering & Problem Solving Able to use AI-assisted engineering tools effectively for software development, analysis, troubleshooting, testing and documentation. Understands prompt and context engineering sufficiently to provide AI tools with the right code, architecture, constraints and engineering context, while critically validating their output.
* Critical Technical Thinking Able to challenge assumptions, work through ambiguous technical problems, evaluate alternative approaches and make sound engineering decisions based on evidence, risk and trade-offs.

**Additional Skills**
**Other Technical Skills**

* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures, messaging and integration patterns
* Containerisation and Kubernetes
* Cloud-native engineering
* Observability and application performance management
* Network fundamentals, particularly HTTP/TLS, DNS, proxies, load balancing and connectivity troubleshooting
* Web and application security

**Human Skills**

* Sets engineering direction, raises technical standards, reviews designs and code, mentors engineers, and remains sufficiently hands-on to guide teams through complex engineering problems.
* Grows Self (Everyone)
* Continuously develops engineering and leadership capability.
* Grows Others (People Leaders)
* Coaches engineers, builds capability and creates strong engineering ownership within the team.
* Grows Bank (Enterprise Leaders)
* Makes technology decisions with an enterprise perspective, balancing delivery, sustainability, security, risk and reuse.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Systems Control Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:
**Main Technical Referent Responsibilities**
Reports regularly on :
  
  
Tracking of progress of System sub project deliverables for next System Releases
  
  
Sub-Project System cost spending & forecast vs Budget
  
  
Contribute to Project Handbook System Development section
  
  
Ensures that working environment and tools of his/her team are set up correctly in alignment with the project, ensure tool qualification

The system TPM updates then weekly the corresponding documents, in accordance with outputs of the reviews done by weekly steering committee chaired by System PM, in which he acts as technical referent.

* Uses delegation to his team members on any topic needing it to be handled properly

* Reports regularly on :

Ability to motivate a team (cross functional & diverse), have them working together to achieve a common goal
  
  
Ability to delegate
  
  
Lead by example (attitude)
  
  
Expected to coach and train R&D team members (e.g. Software; Hardware and other Product Technical leads)
  
  

* Sensitivity - recognizes each person’s strengths, interests, problem and improves their weaknesses

title: Engineering Product Manager
description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
**Your Impact**
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar**
**Your Work Shapes the World**
Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers.
  
  
The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions.
  
  
This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities.
* Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams.
* Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline.
* Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support.
* Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support.
* Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status.
* Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions.
* Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions.
* Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position.
* Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes.
* Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser.
* Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments.

**Education Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum.
* An advanced technical or business degree is preferred.

**What Skills You Will Have**
**Planning: Tactical and Strategic**
Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions.
  
  
**Technical Excellence**
Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations.
  
  
**Decision Making and Critical Thinking**
Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations.
  
  
**Product Design and Development**
Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt.
  
  
**Customer and Market Focus**
Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action.
  
  
**Influencing Through Expertise**
Explains complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; challenges decisions constructively with evidence; builds trust across organisational boundaries; and develops others as credible technical advisers.
  
  
**Collaborating Globally**
Builds networks across functions, regions, dealers, suppliers and customers; reconciles conflicting interests; uses collective expertise to solve complex problems; and creates shared ownership for business results.
  
  
**People Leadership and Career Development**
Develops managers and technical leaders, establishes business-driven development plans, identifies mission-critical capability gaps, supports targeted rotations and learning, and links talent decisions to long-term MineStar needs.
  
  
**Program, Financial and Risk Management**
Manages a portfolio of commitments, budgets, dependencies and risks; establishes transparent operating mechanisms; and intervenes early when delivery, quality, cost or customer outcomes are at risk.
  
  
**Troubleshooting and Production Support**
Directs the structured resolution of complex and non-recurring failures, coordinates internal and external experts, establishes mechanisms for problem tracking and organisational learning, and ensures corrective actions address root causes.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Typically fifteen or more years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, software, systems or product development, including significant leadership responsibility. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers, technical leaders or multiple engineering teams delivering complex products or integrated systems.
* Experience managing product development scope, schedules, budgets, risks and production-support priorities.
* Experience working across organisational boundaries and communicating with senior leaders, customers and external partners.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based decisions and deliver outcomes through others.

**Top Candidates Will Also Have**

* Experience with MineStar, mining technology, autonomy, fleet management, site systems or related digital products.
* Experience with software-intensive and systems-of-systems product development, including cloud and on-premises deployments and integration with machine or site technology.
* Experience implementing Gen AI development tools and practices.
* Knowledge of Caterpillar product development and new product introduction processes, or comparable lifecycle governance in a complex industrial environment.
* Experience modernising established products while maintaining compatibility, quality and customer continuity.
* Demonstrated success developing engineering managers and senior technical talent across global teams.
* Direct experience engaging mining customers, dealers, suppliers and product support organisations.

title: ELN/LIMS configurations expert
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that supports chemical and life sciences organizations in accelerating digital transformation across research, development, laboratory, manufacturing, and operations. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to design and implement digital solutions that make scientific processes more connected and data-driven. Its capabilities span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT works across the full transformation journey—from assessing current processes to implementing ELN/LIMS, integrating data, and enabling scalable analytics and AI. The team is experienced with leading platforms and tools such as LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, SAP Signavio, BPMN, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM platforms.

**Role Description**
For Client based in Europe, we are looking for a ELN/LIMS configurations expert. This role based will be in Chennai, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some work-from-home flexibility. You will connect lab users, data science teams, and IT, ensuring that experimental data is captured in a structured, high-quality, and ML-ready form. The role combines hands-on configuration, product ownership, roll-out coordination for targeted labs and sites, and IT operations.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Configurations and trainings

* Work with lab colleagues to design and configure workflows, data uploaders, templates, and master data especially related to formulation development process (materials, formulations, raw materials, test methods, properties, units)
* Translate lab processes in chemistry and material development into robust platform configurations
* Train users, support onboarding, and drive adoption

2. Product management

* Collect, prioritize, and manage requirements from business stakeholders
* Maintain the product backlog and roadmap, and deliver in an agile (Scrum) setup
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder communication
* Manage releases, change requests, and configuration testing/validation

3. Integrations and IT operations

* Coordinate the development of integrations between the ELN and other systems (LIMS, ERP, PLM, instruments/CDS, data lakes, analytics/ML platforms) via APIs and interfaces
* Handle incident and problem management, second-level support, and vendor coordination
* Maintain knowledge documentation (configuration specs, SOPs, user guides, FAQs)

4. Roll-out and adoption coordination

* Coordinate roll-out activities end-to-end for specific smaller labs or sites (e.g., HTE lab, a particular site roll-out), building on the platform already established in the larger labs
* Reuse and adapt existing configurations, templates, and master data from the larger labs, and identify only the lab-specific extensions needed (e.g., HTE-specific workflows, uploaders, instrument interfaces)
* Define roll-out plans, timelines, and milestones together with the respective lab leads, IT, and data science teams
* Manage change and communication: stakeholder updates, training, user onboarding, and feedback loops
* Track adoption and roll-out KPIs (e.g., active users, workflow usage, open issues) and hand over to operations with complete documentation and support processes

5. Data governance

* Work with ML/data science teams to define rules for good data management (naming conventions, ontologies, mandatory fields, units, metadata)

**Qualifications**

* PhD or master’s degree in a relevant field such as Material science, Chemistry, physics or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience with other ELN/LIMS/R&D platforms
  in chemical or life sciences laboratories including workflow design and data model configuration
  (Preferably Formulation data related experience). With PhD a minimum for 2-3 working experience is required and with Masters a minimum of 7-8 years working experience in required.
* Strong knowledge of application integration (REST APIs, data pipelines, SSO/identity, interfaces between lab and enterprise systems)
* Experience with Scrum/agile, backlog management, and stakeholder prioritization. Certifications such as Scrum Master/PSPO, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications
* Experience with ITIL-based incident/change management
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to collaborate with scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders and to document configurations and processes.
* Good familiarity with data science and ML concepts: data preparation, feature/data requirements, FAIR principles, data modeling
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Chennai, manage priorities independently, and adapt to evolving project requirements and technologies.

description:

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

description:

As an Engineering Manager, you will play a key role in researching and developing innovative products. Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and modern engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve productivity, quality, scalability, and speed to market.

Minimum 6+ years of hard-core coding experience is mandatory
  
  
Excellent hands-on experience in coding in Python/Java, ‘AWS/Microservices will be added advantage’
  
  
Good to have front-end framework knowledge like REACT/Angular.
  
  
Over all 9-13 Experience is mandatory.
  
  
Mandatory 2+ years of people management experience required .

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
Consulting Manager role for a global organization focusing on property and casualty insurance clients responsible for driving complex consulting engagements optimizing business processes and enhancing operational efficiency in a hybrid work model. The role demands eight to ten years of relevant experience and deep domain expertise to deliver measurable outcomes for insurers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end consulting engagements for property and casualty insurance clients by defining problem statements structuring approach and ensuring delivery of measurable business outcomes that strengthen client competitiveness and operational resilience.
* Oversee analysis of underwriting policy administration billing and claims processes to identify efficiency gaps control weaknesses and transformation opportunities that improve loss ratios service quality and regulatory compliance.
* Provide expert guidance on property and casualty insurance products rating methodologies and risk selection practices to help clients refine portfolio strategies and enhance sustainable profitability.
* Drive development of detailed business requirements user stories and process maps for core insurance platforms and surrounding applications to support system enhancements and digital transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders across business operations technology and compliance functions to align consulting recommendations with strategic priorities and practical implementation constraints.
* Develop clear and compelling presentations reports and business cases that translate complex analysis and insurance concepts into actionable insights for executives and operational leaders.
* Collaborate with technology teams to support design and validation of solutions such as workflow automation data analytics models and self service capabilities that streamline property and casualty insurance operations.
* Monitor engagement progress through well defined milestones risks and dependencies while recommending corrective actions to maintain scope quality and timelines in a hybrid work environment.
* Guide change management activities by proposing communication plans training approaches and adoption metrics that help client teams embrace new processes and systems without disruption to daily service delivery.
* Evaluate key performance indicators across claims handling customer service and policy servicing to recommend continuous improvement initiatives that enhance client satisfaction and reduce operating costs.
* Support sales and account teams by contributing domain expertise solution concepts and effort estimates for proposals targeting property and casualty insurance organizations.
* Ensure that all consulting deliverables reflect current regulatory expectations market trends and emerging risks in property and casualty insurance so clients can make informed strategic decisions.
* Document lessons learned reusable frameworks and best practices from each engagement to strengthen organizational knowledge capital and improve future project effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bring eight to ten years of experience in consulting or business analysis roles with a strong focus on property and casualty insurance operations and transformation programs.
* Demonstrate in depth understanding of underwriting workflows policy lifecycle management claims adjudication and associated controls within property and casualty insurance.
* Exhibit proficiency in process analysis requirements gathering and stakeholder management to translate client needs into practical and clearly defined consulting deliverables.
* Apply solid analytical and problem solving skills using data driven approaches to evaluate performance metrics and recommend realistic improvement options for insurance clients.
* Show familiarity with core insurance platforms and related tools used in property and casualty carriers to effectively support system enhancement and modernization initiatives.
* Display strong communication and presentation capabilities to engage diverse stakeholders and explain complex property and casualty topics in accessible business language.
* Maintain adaptability to work in a hybrid model with effective time management and collaboration skills that support cross functional project teams across locations.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
