title: CAPEX Excellence specialist
description:
**Support CAPEX planning, execution and reporting**
Join NKT in a role that connects CAPEX governance, system support, and business improvement across an international organization. You will own day-to-day support, adoption, and continuous improvement of the CAPEX tool, helping teams work with consistent data, reliable reporting, and clear processes. This is a valuable opportunity to contribute to the green transition by supporting investment decisions across the business. Are you motivated by combining systems, process standards, and user support in one role?
  
  
**Keep CAPEX operations stable and consistent**
In this role, you will act as the main business contact for the CAPEX tool and related process standards. You will support users, coordinate incidents and improvement requests with, and help maintain common templates, workflows, and reporting standards. The role also includes governance of master data, backlog prioritization, UAT coordination, and communication around releases and changes. You will work closely with CAPEX project managers, finance, procurement, IT, and process owners to support reliable planning, execution, and tracking across sites and functions.
  
  
**Your Responsibility Will Be To**

* Provide first-line functional support and coordinate further support when needed
* Maintain user guides, SOPs, and training materials
* Govern usage standards, workflows, and documentation requirements
* Support reports and dashboards with consistent KPI definitions
* Coordinate UAT, releases and backlog priorities

You will work across manufacturing sites and shared functions, in close collaboration with CAPEX project managers, site controllers, procurement and IT.
  
  
**Structured communicator with a clear quality focus**
We are looking for someone who is service-minded, and organized, with a practical approach to user support and process governance. You communicate clearly with both end users and management, work carefully with documentation and change control, and are comfortable balancing business needs with standard ways of working. The right person is initiative-taking, detail-oriented, and able to move issues forward while keeping compliance, auditability, and data quality in focus.
  
  
**You Also Have**

* 5+ years of experience in CAPEX controlling, project execution, PMO, finance, or a similar area using CAPEX, ERP, or project portfolio tools
* Experience translating business needs into system requirements and supporting UAT, training, and change management
* Good understanding of data structures, reporting, and integrations with finance or ERP systems
* Experience acting as system or product owner
* Training or certification in ERP/PM systems or project management

**Help improve investment quality for a greener future**
NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We are motivated to establish gender diversity at NKT and encourage all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment.
  
  
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative international setting where you can broaden your skills in CAPEX governance, systems, reporting, and change processes. You will work with colleagues across business functions and sites, contribute to continuous improvement, and support reliable investment planning that matters to NKT’s ongoing journey and the wider green transition.
  
  
“This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting systems, process standards, and user needs to create reliable CAPEX planning and reporting across the business,” says Hiring Manager, Karim Damiani
  
  
Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!
  
  
We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 20th November 2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.
  
  
We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.
  
  
Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!
  
  
**About NKT**
*NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com*

title: Technology Manager
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We're looking for a Technology Manager to make sure our IT changes and tech ecosystem are safe and well-managed. You'll be working closely with our Operations and Product teams to keep projects on track. We need a brilliant problem solver who's passionate about IT systems and networks.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Assessing initiatives that require IT changes
* Identifying dependencies, impact, and risks, and making sure they're properly analysed, tested, and managed
* Representing the Technology team in larger change and transformation programmes, and taking ownership of relevant tasks
* Building and optimising scalable processes to support Revolut's hyper-growth
* Leading and executing projects end to end
* Preparing reports and keeping directors and other stakeholders updated
* Resolving issues with management and stakeholders

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of experience in financial services or fintech, or at a leading technology or IT services provider
* Programme and project management qualifications, plus in-depth knowledge of their methods and principles
* A talent for breaking complex problems into smaller ones, and to enjoy working with data
* Risk awareness and an understanding of risk management frameworks, especially the three lines of defence model
* A solid grasp of technology within a financial services organisation, including modern tech stacks
* Knowledge of European financial services regulations, such as PSD2, GDPR, and the Digital Operational Resilience Act
* Experience partnering with executive teams and working closely with others to deliver results
* A background in retail banking and familiarity with Revolut's products and services
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills
* Sharp decision-making skills and the ability to analyse complex information, identify key issues, and drive resolutions

**Nice to have**

* Technology and change delivery experience at a leading global consultancy
* A track record of building or scaling the technology function of a financial services institution or fintech
* Relevant certifications, such as CCMP, ITIL, or PMP

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

**We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.**
If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
  
  
By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead
description:
**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**
**GCL: F**
**Location: Chennai**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?
  
  
In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.
  
  
Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment—from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. We value kindness alongside ambition, recognize meaningful contributions and create space for diverse minds to collaborate, learn fast and shape how an entire enterprise uses data and AI to create patient impact.
  
  
**Call To Action**
Step into this role to architect the AI foundations of drug development and amplify your impact—share your profile and start shaping what’s next.
  
  
**Date Posted**
13-Oct-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Principal - Solution Engineering

To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There's another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

As a GSI Solution Architect, you will be the technical and solution engine behind our Global Systems Integrator ecosystem, with a dedicated focus on Employee Experience and Freshservice.

You will help GSI partners find, shape, and progress new business and expansion opportunities — bringing solution credibility to early conversations, turning employee service challenges into structured opportunities, and building the assets and capability that let partners eventually run these motions themselves.

You will work day-to-day with two Business Development colleagues and our GSI Partner Managers, and partner closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Professional Services. This is a commercially aligned role — you will be measured on partner-sourced ARR — but it is not a pure sales role. Solution leadership, partner enablement, and technical credibility are the core of the job.

* Work with GSI partners to identify and shape new Freshservice opportunities linked to employee service transformation.
* Support early-stage discovery with partner teams and end customers, translating service challenges into structured solution opportunities.
* Build solution narratives across ITSM modernisation, employee self-service, workflow automation, knowledge management, and legacy ITSM migration.
* Identify where existing EX or ITSM footprints can expand into broader Enterprise Service Management — HR, Finance, Facilities, Legal, Procurement, Security, and Operations.
* Position AI as a practical accelerator: self-service, ticket deflection, agent assist, knowledge discovery, and automation.
* Equip our two Business Development colleagues with messaging, discovery questions, and qualification guides, and join calls where solution credibility is needed.
* Deliver enablement sessions for GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams, and support their certification and readiness.
* Create reusable assets — demo flows, reference architectures, discovery guides, and partner playbooks — that scale beyond any single deal.
* Support partner account planning and contribute to the quality and conversion of partner-sourced pipeline.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Experience in solution architecture, presales, consulting, or partner solution engineering.
* Strong understanding of Employee Experience, ITSM, ESM, service desk modernisation, and internal service delivery.
* Experience working with GSIs, systems integrators, consulting firms, or other partner-led business models.
* Ability to build EX, ESM, and AI solution narratives, and to support both new business and expansion motions.
* Understanding of AI use cases in service management — self-service, agent assist, automation, knowledge, and ticket deflection.
* Experience creating demos, discovery guides, enablement content, and reference architectures.
* Comfortable being commercially aligned to partner-sourced ARR.
* Strong stakeholder management across partner, sales, product, and technical teams, with excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Based in or able to work from Chennai.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, or similar ITSM/ESM platforms.
* Experience supporting partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue motions, or GSI-led transformation programmes.
* Experience working with Indian or global GSI partners.
* Familiarity with ITIL, workflow automation, and internal service operations.
* Ability to build business cases, value propositions, and repeatable go-to-market plays.
* Experience supporting migrations from legacy ITSM platforms.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

You will also support portfolio operations, demand planning, Program Increment (PI) Planning, customer research, executive reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
We are looking for a proactive leader who can navigate ambiguity, influence across organizational boundaries, and translate customer and technology needs into executable plans
  
  
****Responsibilities****
*What you'll do*
Short Description

Our team is instrumental in steering the Platform Transformation, encompassing approximately 2000 team members, and covering platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, Application Hosting, High Performance Computing, Networking, and Employee Experience. Additionally, we have Product Management responsibilities for infrastructure initiatives like the Threat Detection and Response Platform, Manufacturing CaaS, China Data Center Optimization, and Azure B2C. is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build next-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high-impact products.

You will own the product end-to-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high-performing, differentiated products.

  Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post-launch impact

* You think in
  **products, not projects**
* You start with the

* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are
  **data-driven**
  , using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about
  **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 4+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end-to-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

The
**Zendesk Platform Product Owner**

Operating at the intersection of CX strategy and technical execution, the PPO ensures that the Zendesk platform architecture remains robust, scalable, secure, and fully aligned with both current and emerging organizational capabilities.
  
  
As a key strategic partner, the PPO works closely with Business Capability Owners (BCOs) across Global Customer Care, Technical Support, and Operations to translate CX objectives into an actionable, forward-looking Zendesk technology roadmap. The role demands hands-on leadership, extensive domain expertise across the Zendesk Suite, custom app integrations, and significant proficiency in platform architecture, automation, and enterprise routing. Reporting to the Head of Platforms, the PPO leads, develops, and mentors the Platform Engineering and Administration team.
  
  
**Your Contribution:**
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
  
  

* Strategic Platform Ownership and Governance: Define and execute the Zendesk platform architecture and technical roadmap in alignment with BCO priorities. Drive platform governance by establishing standards for configuration management, custom code, API usage, data security, and release cycles.
* Technical Leadership and Hands-on Execution: Act as the "Chief Practitioner" for Zendesk, applying deep hands-on expertise across Zendesk Support, Guide, Talk, Messaging, Explore, and Sunshine. Lead the architecture of complex workflows, custom apps (ZAF framework), webhook integrations with ERP/CRM systems, and advanced ticket routing strategies.
* Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and grow the Zendesk engineering and admin team. Define technical career paths, conduct code/configuration reviews, and unblock complex technical challenges to maintain high delivery velocity.
* Stakeholder Collaboration and Communication: Serve as the primary interface between CX leadership and engineering teams. Translate business needs into detailed technical user stories, while communicating platform roadmaps, risks, and performance metrics to non-technical stakeholders.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience designing, configuring, and delivering enterprise customer service platform solutions.
* 5+ years in a Product Owner, Platform Manager, or Enterprise Solution Architect role focused on Zendesk.
* Deep technical proficiency across the entire Zendesk ecosystem (Support, Guide, Explore, Messaging/Chat, Talk, Gather, and Sunshine platform).
* Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk Apps Framework (ZAF), Zendesk REST APIs, Liquid markup, Webhooks, JSON, and custom Zendesk App development.
* Proven experience integrating Zendesk with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle ERP, middleware (e.g., MuleSoft, Workato), and data warehouses.
* Practical expertise in configuring complex ticket routing, triggers, automations, SLAs, security controls, and custom objects/data models.
* Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum product management, backlog prioritization, and non-functional requirements (scalability, GDPR/compliance, system performance).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting technical strategies to senior leaders.

* Zendesk Certified Expert / Master Administrator or Zendesk Certified App Developer.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent Agile certification.
* Deep proficiency with project/portfolio management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Monday.com).
* Experience with AI/bot integrations (Zendesk AI, custom LLM integrations, or third-party conversational AI platforms).

title: Director, Process Management Core, Lead

* Identify, assess, monitor, and manage risks related to tooling stability, data quality, compliance, and vendor dependency
* Ensure appropriate controls, monitoring, and escalation processes are in place

* Establish and maintain clear governance, standards, and controls for ARIS usage and change
* Ensure transparency through tracking, reporting, and stakeholder communications
* Maintain documentation and audit‑ready artefacts for tooling governance

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct
* Take personal responsibility for ensuring ARIS tooling complies with all applicable laws, regulations, and Group standards
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters

* Group Transformation Office
* Process Excellence Team
* Global Process Owners, Process element Owners and Domain Owners
* Process Universe Champions
* Technology and Data teams
* Resilience, Risk and Compliance
* External vendors - ARIS

* Expert level experience with ARIS in an enterprise or regulated environment

* Experience working across global, multi stakeholder environments
* Strategic mindset with strong execution discipline
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability

* Confident, pragmatic, and resilient in managing ambiguity and change

**Skills And Experience**

* Process Tooling / ARIS expertise
* Tool governance & operating models
* Vendor & release management
* Communications
* Process Excellence & enablement

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

**What We Offer**

we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

title: Product Owner
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Caterpillar products generate and process large volumes of real-time data from sensors, onboard models, and control systems, enabling advanced operational insights across mining environments. As part of Caterpillar’s digital strategy, the MineStar suite delivers an integrated platform that connects machines and enterprise systems to enable real-time monitoring, control, and optimisation of mining operations.
  
  
To support this vision, we are evolving our software delivery model through a
**DevSecOps approach**
, embedding security, automation, and operational excellence across the software lifecycle.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Product Owner – DevSecOps**
to lead prioritisation and delivery within a DevSecOps enablement team. This role focuses on enabling engineering teams to deliver software
**faster, more securely, and with greater reliability**
through platform capabilities, standardised pipelines, and integrated security practices.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Product Owner – DevSecOps is responsible for defining and prioritising the backlog for DevSecOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, security controls, and developer enablement services.
  
  
The role acts as the bridge between
**engineering, security, platform, and business stakeholders**
, ensuring that DevSecOps investments deliver measurable improvements in delivery velocity, quality, security, and compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* DevSecOps Backlog Ownership

+ Own and prioritise the DevSecOps backlog, aligning with platform strategy, security requirements, and engineering needs.
+ Define and sequence features such as CI/CD pipelines, IaC capabilities, environment provisioning, and security tooling.

* Program Increment (PI) Planning & Delivery

+ Lead backlog refinement and planning activities for Program Increments, ensuring clear, prioritised, and outcome-driven deliverables.
+ Ensure features deliver measurable improvements in automation, standardisation, and developer experience.

* Security & Compliance Integration

+ Drive the inclusion of security controls (e.g., scanning, secrets management, policy-as-code) into delivery pipelines.
+ Ensure alignment with enterprise compliance frameworks and audit requirements (e.g., ISO, governance standards).

* Platform & Enablement Focus

+ Prioritise initiatives that enable self-service, reusable “golden paths,” and standardised DevSecOps patterns across teams.
+ Balance platform standardisation with product team flexibility and adoption.

* Technical Alignment & Architecture Enablement

+ Collaborate with architects and technical leads to support architectural runway, including infrastructure modernisation, pipeline standardisation, and reduction of technical debt.
+ Ensure adequate backlog allocation for platform capabilities and engineering enablement.

* Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

+ Act as the primary interface between DevSecOps teams and stakeholders across engineering, security, and leadership.
+ Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes.

* Value Delivery & Continuous Improvement

+ Define success metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time, security posture, incident reduction).
+ Continuously refine priorities based on feedback, adoption, and performance data.

**Experience Required**

* 4+ years’ experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in software delivery environments.
* Experience working with DevOps or DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD, cloud platforms, or infrastructure automation.
* Proven experience working within Agile frameworks (SAFe, Scrum, etc.).
* Experience delivering platform or enablement capabilities (preferred).

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles, including automation, security integration, and continuous delivery.
* Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into business value outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management across engineering, security, and leadership domains.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to prioritise high-impact initiatives.
* Strong communication and influencing skills in complex, cross-functional environments.
* Familiarity with modern engineering ecosystems (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, cloud platforms, IaC tools).

**Compensation & Benefits**
Competitive salary based on degree and professional industry working experience. The Total Rewards package includes:
  
  

* Competitive remuneration package
* Attractive Bonus and Share options
* Career development with global prospects
* A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing
* An inclusive workplace culture focused on quality, customer service and the environment
* A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity, and equal outcome
* SMART spending APP
* The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents.

**Additional Information**
Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Relocation is available for this position.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 12, 2026 - October 25, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Head of Digital Platforms & Customer Experience COE - Senior Vice President
description:
**Role Purpose**
Lead the digital platforms and end-to-end customer experience agenda for UAE Wealth, creating differentiated, seamless and trusted experiences across the full client lifecycle.
  
  
The role brings together digital platform strategy and execution, customer experience, complaints and root-cause management, governance and regulatory readiness, third-party oversight, and AI-enabled transformation. The mandate is to ensure digital capabilities translate into measurable client and business outcomes while maintaining strong governance, controls and operational resilience.
  
  
A critical leadership priority is to build a world-class, high-performing and future-ready team, using AI and new ways of working to materially improve how the organization designs, delivers, governs and continuously improves client experiences.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Digital Platforms Strategy & Leadership
* Own the UAE Wealth digital platforms agenda and define the strategic roadmap across client and banker experiences.
* Drive adoption, simplification and continuous enhancement of digital capabilities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible client and business outcomes.
* Connect platform strategy to the broader Digital Growth and Wealth Continuum agenda, identifying opportunities to digitize and reimagine journeys.
* Champion AI-first thinking, applying AI and automation to transform client experiences, employee workflows and platform management.
* End-to-End Customer Experience
* Own the client experience across the lifecycle, from onboarding and transacting through servicing and ongoing relationship management.
* Establish a strong voice-of-client discipline using NPS, complaints, feedback and other experience signals to identify systemic opportunities for improvement.
* Translate client insights into prioritized interventions across digital, process, servicing and people dimensions.
* Set clear experience standards across channels and ensure digital and human interactions operate as one cohesive journey.
* Complaints, Root Cause & Experience Management
* Establish rigorous management of complaints and material experience failures, moving beyond issue resolution toward prevention.
* Apply structured root-cause analysis across process/technology, behavioral and systemic dimensions.
* Partner across Platforms, Operations, Controls, Segments and other stakeholders to address underlying causes and reduce recurrence.
* Build management visibility of material experience issues and drive actions through sustainable closure.
* Holistic Third-Party Governance
* Provide holistic oversight of third parties supporting digital platforms and customer experiences.
* Establish clear governance across third-party performance, service quality, controls, resilience, risk and issue management.
* Ensure third-party dependencies are understood across the end-to-end client journey rather than managed in functional silos.
* Drive clear accountability and escalation for material third-party risks and service failures.
* Governance & Regulatory Leadership
* Bring strong understanding of the UAE governance and regulatory landscape and translate regulatory expectations into sustainable platform and customer-experience practices.
* Embed appropriate governance throughout digital platform strategy, design, delivery and ongoing management.
* Partner closely with Risk, Controls, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Technology to anticipate emerging requirements and maintain regulatory readiness.
* Establish transparent governance forums, management information and escalation mechanisms for key platform and customer-experience risks.
* AI-Enabled Transformation
* Set an ambitious agenda for AI across customer experiences, employee productivity, analytics, controls and platform operations.
* Identify opportunities to redesign work and experiences, rather than simply automate existing processes.
* Embed appropriate governance, risk management and accountability into AI-enabled capabilities.
* Build AI fluency across the team so emerging technology becomes part of everyday problem-solving and delivery.
* Build a World-Class Team
* Build and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization spanning digital platforms, customer experience, product thinking, governance, data and AI.
* Create an environment of strong ownership, client obsession, constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* Develop future-ready talent through targeted capability building, broader exposure and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Foster active engagement and psychological safety so issues and opportunities surface early, while maintaining clear accountability and high execution standards.

**Key Measures of Success**

* Digital adoption and platform engagement
* Client experience and NPS improvement
* Reduction in complaint volumes and recurrence
* Digital journey completion and servicing effectiveness
* Platform reliability and operational resilience
* Third-party performance, risk and issue closure
* Regulatory and governance outcomes
* Root-cause and management-action closure
* AI adoption and measurable productivity and experience improvements
* Team capability, engagement and talent development

**Scope & Authority**
The role has broad cross-functional reach across Digital, Segments, Product, Onboarding, Servicing, Technology, Operations, Governance, Risk, Controls, Compliance and third-party partners.
  
  
The Center of Excellene role will represent the combined digital platform and client-experience agenda in senior UAE management and governance forums, convene stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues, and drive accountability for material platform and customer-experience outcomes.
  
  
**Candidate Profile**

* 12+ years of experience in wealth management, banking, digital platforms, technology-enabled transformation or customer experience, with substantial senior leadership exposure.
* Proven ability to lead complex digital platforms and end-to-end transformation in a highly regulated environment.
* Strong customer orientation, with experience translating customer insights and complaints into systemic improvements.
* Deep understanding of governance, risk and regulatory expectations, ideally within the UAE or a comparable regulated financial-services market.
* Demonstrated ability to govern complex ecosystems involving technology and third-party providers.
* Strong understanding of AI and emerging digital capabilities, with the ability to translate technology into practical customer, employee and business outcomes.
* Track record of building and developing world-class teams, attracting strong talent and creating future-ready capabilities.
* Strong executive presence and ability to influence across Technology, Business, Operations, Risk and Control functions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Commercial judgment and the ability to balance client outcomes, growth, innovation, regulatory obligations and risk management.
* SVP/C14 gravitas to represent UAE Digital Platforms & Customer Experience with senior management and relevant governance forums.

* Apply Lean / Six Sigma principles alongside digital tools to eliminate waste, lower carbon footprints (sustainable logistics), and enhance supply chain resilience.

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable AI technical roadmaps.
* Change Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, from plant floor operators to executive leadership.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile environments for software and product development.
* Communication: Exceptional storytelling and executive presentation skills with the ability to articulate technical AI concepts in clear business terms.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations research, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 8–12 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Material Planning and Logistics areas.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, analytics, automation, or digital transformation initiatives in a manufacturing or automotive environment.
* Proven track record of taking AI/ML or advanced analytics projects from concept to production with measurable business impact

title: Catalog Manager
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Catalogue Executive is responsible for managing the organization's product catalogue across all categories, ensuring every product is accurately represented in catalogues, quotation tools, and internal systems. The role focuses on catalogue accuracy, product data management, new product launches, SKU management, pricing updates, and supporting seamless collaboration between Category, Procurement, Design, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams. The objective is to maintain ascalable, standardized, and error\-free catalogue that enables excellent customer experience and
 



 efficient business operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Catalogue Management:** 



* Manage and maintain the master product catalogue, ensuring all product information is accurate, standardized, and up to date across all cities and platforms.
* Create, modify, and archive product records, ensuring discontinued products are removed and new products are added as per approved timelines.
* Maintain a consistent category hierarchy, product groupings, and catalogue version control.



  





**2\. Product Data Management:** 



* Ensure complete and accurate product information, including specifications, dimensions, finishes, materials, warranties, images, and descriptions.
* Validate product data received from vendors and internal stakeholders before publishing it in the catalogue
* Maintain data consistency across catalogues, quotation tools, and other business systems.



  





**3\. Pricing Management:** 



* Update product pricing, discounts, and commercial information based on approved price revisions from the Category and Procurement teams.
* Verify pricing accuracy before releasing updates to ensure error\-free quotations and customer proposals.
* Maintain historical pricing records and support periodic price revisions.



  





**4\. Product Launch Management:** 



* Coordinate the end\-to end catalogue readiness for new product launches, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, and documentation are available.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure products are launched within committed timelines.
* Support the preparation of product launch materials, catalogues, and internal communication.



  





**5\. SKU Management:** 



* Create and maintain unique SKU codes for all products while ensuring there are no duplicate or incorrect entries.
* Update SKU mappings whenever products are modified, discontinued, or introduced.
* Maintain the master SKU database to support inventory, quotation, and reporting systems.



  





**6\. Quote Builder \& System Management:** 



* Coordinate with the Tech team to upload new products, pricing updates, and configuration changes into the Quote Builder and related systems.
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate data accuracy before system releases.
* Report and follow up on system issues to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.



  





**7\. Vendor Coordination:** 



* Liaise with vendors to collect product catalogues, images, specifications, pricing, warranty information, and other required documentation.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely submission of updated product information.
* Maintain organized records of all vendor documents and communications.



  





**8\. Documentation Management:** 



* Maintain and regularly update product rate cards, technical specifications, installation guidelines, comparison sheets, and other catalogue\-related documents.
* Ensure all documentation follows company standards and version control practices.
* Support the preparation of internal reference documents for Sales, Design, and Operations teams.



  





**9\. Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Collaborate closely with Category, Procurement, Partners to ensure seamless catalogue updates.
* Communicate product changes, launches, and pricing revisions to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives aimed at improving catalogue quality and business efficiency.



  





**10\. Catalogue Quality Control:** 



* Conduct regular audits to verify the accuracy of product information, pricing, images, specifications, and category mappings.
* Identify and resolve catalogue discrepancies before they impact customer quotations or project execution.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance catalogue accuracy, consistency, and operational efficiency.



  





**Educational Qualification:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Data Management or Information Management, or a related field.
* Experience in the Interior Industry is an added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum 2 years of experience in Catalogue Management, Product Management, Procurement Coordination, or Data Management.



  





**SKILLS REQUIRED:** 



* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* Data Validation
* Basic ERP/CRM understanding
* Version Control Behavioural Skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to coordinate effectively with cross\-functional teams and external vendors
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Process\-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and a proactive approach to work
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes

**Business Vertical:**

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**

* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.

* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.

title: SME-Product info & MDM
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid night shift role focuses on managing product information and master data to support efficient order management and trading operations for an MNC. The SME will optimize data flows between systems ensure accuracy of product and order records and collaborate with cross functional teams to improve retail order processes. The role contributes directly to customer satisfaction and stable trading performance by maintaining reliable data foundations and supporting continuous improvement a
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end ownership of product information and master data flows for order management and trading systems ensuring accurate synchronized data across core platforms to support consistent execution and reliable reporting
* Manage creation update and maintenance of product master records including attributes hierarchies pricing and availability so that downstream order and trading processes operate with clean structured data
* Coordinate closely with order management operations teams to analyze data issues impacting order capture fulfillment and settlement and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence and reduce manual interventions
* Collaborate with trading and commercial stakeholders to define data rules for item setup bundle management and promotional constructs ensuring that business strategies are reflected reliably in system configurations
* Monitor nightly data loads and interface jobs across hybrid environments addressing exceptions in near real time to secure uninterrupted processing and timely visibility for global teams
* Design and maintain data quality checks and validation routines that detect anomalies in product and order data enabling early remediation and continuous improvement of master data standards
* Document functional data models for order management and trading processes translating complex concepts into clear reference materials that support onboarding and knowledge sharing across teams
* Partner with technology teams to refine mapping logic between product information management master data management and order platforms focusing on performance scalability and resilience of integrations
* Support incident analysis for data related defects in night shift operations providing structured root cause insights and proposing pragmatic solutions that enhance customer experience and operational stability
* Contribute to process optimization initiatives across retail order flows by proposing enhancements to data structures configuration rules and workflows that reduce cycle times and improve order accuracy
* Engage with stakeholders in hybrid working sessions to gather requirements for new product and order data capabilities and convert them into well defined specifications that guide implementation and testing
* Perform impact assessments for product and master data changes across reporting billing and trading processes ensuring that dependencies are understood and that transitions are executed safely without disruption
* Promote adoption of master data governance practices through clear communication of standards guidance on best practices and active participation in forums that strengthen data discipline across the organization


**Qualifications**
* Possess four to seven years of hands on experience as a subject matter expert in product information and master data within complex order management and trading environments demonstrating strong ownership of data outcomes
* Bring solid practical expertise working with core order management platforms and trading systems including configuration troubleshooting and data analysis to keep high volume operations running smoothly
* Apply demonstrated exposure to retail order management scenarios such as omnichannel ordering and inventory visibility translating domain understanding into better data design and process alignment
* Show capability in documenting requirements user stories and data dictionaries in a clear and structured manner making it easier for cross functional teams to deliver enhancements and maintain solutions
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills using data profiling and issue analysis techniques to identify root causes of product and order data problems and to recommend sustainable corrective actions
* Operate effectively in a hybrid work model and dedicated night shift environment maintaining proactive communication and coordination with onshore and offshore partners without needing travel
* Exhibit familiarity with master data management principles including governance stewardship and lifecycle management applying them to improve reliability and reusability of product and order data assets

 **hybrid** 
 position.

title: Principal Technical Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 Help build the enterprise AI runtime and agentic platform that will power AI solutions across Optum.
   

  

 AI Factory Runtime and Agentic Platform Services provides a secure, scalable platform that enables engineering teams to deploy and operate AI workloads and agents across private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments.
   

  

 As Principal Technical Product Manager \- AI Runtime, Agentic Platform \& Compute, you will own the product strategy for this critical layer of AI Factory. You will transform GPU compute, Kubernetes, model serving, inference, agent runtimes, agent orchestration, multi\-agent execution, lifecycle management, and observability into enterprise services that development teams can easily consume.
   

  

 You will define the product vision, roadmap, service model, and investment priorities while partnering with Engineering, Compute, Cloud, Security, Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Architecture leaders to build a high\-performance enterprise AI platform.
   

  

 This role owns the AI runtime, compute, and operational agent platform experience. It does not own underlying physical infrastructure, enterprise model approval and Responsible AI policy processes, or the business\-specific agents, AI applications, and solutions built by consuming teams.
   

  

 AI can only scale across the enterprise when engineering teams have secure, reliable, and easy\-to\-consume runtime and agent platform capabilities beneath their solutions.
   

  

 You will turn advanced GPU, Kubernetes, AI runtime, and agent execution technologies into standardized enterprise services that help teams move AI workloads and agents into production faster, while integrating with enterprise\-approved model access, security, and governance services.

* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, service models, SLOs/SLAs, adoption metrics, consumption models, and investment priorities

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:

 1\. Monthly visits to regional competition to benchmark the regional products offered, weight bands, making charge ...etc.

 ITSRA is seeking an experienced, motivated and ambitious Business Analyst with extensive experience in Capital Markets domains with primary focus in the areas of Issuances, Valuation, Settlement, Accounting, Liquidity management as well as knowledge of external ratings of securities and financial counterparts.

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience

description:

 Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP\-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper\-focused, domain\-centered teams and cutting\-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real\-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future\-focused outcomes.
   

  

**Job Brief**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and hands\-on Lead AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-scale AI products. This role combines technical leadership with deep engineering expertise, requiring active involvement in product feature architecture, full\-stack application development, AI/ML model integration, code reviews, release management, and engineering best practices within our AI Product Engineering team.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Cloud Technologies, and modern full\-stack development, with a proven ability to lead technical teams while remaining actively engaged in coding. They should be passionate about building scalable, production\-ready AI products, mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and collaborating with Product Managers and cross\-functional teams to transform product requirements into robust, high\-performance AI\-powered product features.
   

  

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
* 4 to 6\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with strong coding expertise.
* Strong programming experience in Python (Mandatory).
* Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, AI Agents, and Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with Vector Databases and Enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, or equivalent.
* Proven experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise\-grade applications.
* Strong expertise in Full Stack Development: Backend (Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Frontend (React.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3\).
* Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices.
* Strong understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns, and Domain\-Driven Design (DDD).
* Hands\-on experience building, training, fine\-tuning, and deploying Machine Learning models.
* Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoost.
* Experience deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments and implementing MLOps practices.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure Cloud Platforms (Mandatory).
* Experience with cloud\-native development, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event\-driven architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and security best practices.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full\-stack applications using Python and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Build and deploy Machine Learning and AI\-powered solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Actively contribute to coding, code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization activities.
* Develop and maintain REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures following industry best practices.
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and MLOps processes.
* Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications and ML models on AWS and/or Azure.
* Ensure high standards of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers.
* Drive continuous improvement in architecture, development processes, security, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical design, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance products and platforms.
* Work in Agile teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and successful delivery of project milestones.
* Own and evolve specific modules/features within Firstsource's AI product suite, maintaining a technical backlog in partnership with Product Management.
* Conduct usability, performance, and scalability testing across product releases and drive iterative improvements based on internal and client feedback loops.
* Support release planning, versioning, and product documentation for engineering and support teams.


**Experience \& Education**
* 4\-6\+ years of overall experience.
* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an Engineering discipline.

description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

**Job Requirements (JR)**
 Senior Manager (B4\-1\) \- Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the strategy, product development, transformation, onboarding, orchestration, and engineering evolution of the Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) portfolio, encompassing SD\-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Internet Access.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Lead\-to\-Order (L2O), Order\-to\-Cash/Order\-to\-Billing (O2C/O2B), and Trouble\-to\-Resolve (T2R) customer journeys, service orchestration platforms, AI\-enabled automation, API\-driven ecosystems, and cloud\-native security architectures. The position will drive seamless customer onboarding, service lifecycle management, policy\-based provisioning, and Zero\-Touch MACD (Move, Add, Change, Delete) operations across the SASE portfolio while enabling scalable digital service delivery and customer experience transformation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**SASE Product Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Drive product strategy, portfolio evolution, onboarding, and lifecycle management for SASE services including SD\-WAN, SSE, and Secure Internet Access.
* Define and execute product roadmaps aligned with enterprise security, cloud transformation, and digital connectivity strategies.
* Lead portfolio modernization initiatives to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, and service adoption.
* Partner with business, product management, security architecture, and commercial teams to develop next\-generation managed SASE offerings.


**Product Development \& Engineering Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end telecom and security software product development, release governance, roadmap execution, and portfolio transformation.
* Lead engineering teams responsible for service onboarding, orchestration, workflow automation, and customer lifecycle management.
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, and microservices\-based architectures across SASE platforms.

**Job Description**
